007e9eede1bcbf2e.zh: 主語「시간이」接原因「없으니까」，後接副詞「빨리」修飾「가요」。
007e9eede1bcbf2e.en: 시간이 connects to reason 없으니까, followed by adverb 빨리 modifying the verb 가요.

0217ab27f179d103.en: 춥다 is a ㅂ-irregular adjective, becoming 추우- plus ㄴ: 추운.
0217ab27f179d103.zh: 「춥다」為ㅂ不規則形容詞，遇母音變為「추우-」再加「ㄴ」。

0217ab27f179d103.en: Because 춥다 is irregular with ㅂ, it cannot simply add 은.
0217ab27f179d103.zh: 「춥다」是ㅂ不規則變化，不能直接規則接「-은」。

0217ab27f179d103.en: -는 modifies nouns with verbs, not with standard adjectives like 춥다.
0217ab27f179d103.zh: 「-는」用於動詞，形容詞不使用「-는」修飾名詞。

0217ab27f179d103.en: 추워 is a sentence-ending form, not an adnominal form modifying 날씨.
0217ab27f179d103.zh: 「추워」是非格式體終結詞尾，不可直接放在名詞前修飾。

02b475a16bf568f8.zh: 「-기로 하다」表示約定或決定，接在動詞詞幹後正好符合句意。
02b475a16bf568f8.en: The pattern -기로 하다 expresses a decision or promise, correctly attaching to the verb stem.

02b475a16bf568f8.zh: 「-기를」是受格名詞形助詞，不能與「하다」搭配表示約定做某事。
02b475a16bf568f8.en: The particle -기를 marks an object clause and does not form the grammar pattern for making decisions.

02b475a16bf568f8.zh: 「-기에」通常表示原因或基準，不能接「했어요」表示決定。
02b475a16bf568f8.en: The ending -기에 indicates a cause or standard and does not pair with 했어요 for decisions.

02b475a16bf568f8.zh: 「-기로서」不是表示約定的形式；約定、決定要用「-기로 하다」。
02b475a16bf568f8.en: -기로서 is not a form for agreeing on something; an agreement or decision is -기로 하다.

02f793a48f14a437.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 지 [時間]이/가 되다」為固定句型，時間名詞後接主格助詞「-이」。
02f793a48f14a437.en: In the pattern V-(으)ㄴ 지 [time]이/가 되다, the time expression takes the subject particle 이.

02f793a48f14a437.zh: 「-을」為受格助詞，「되다」是不及物動詞，不能接受格助詞。
02f793a48f14a437.en: The particle 을 marks a direct object, but the intransitive verb 되다 requires a subject marker.

02f793a48f14a437.zh: 「-에」表示時間點或地點，不符合此句型的結構。
02f793a48f14a437.en: The particle 에 indicates a point in time or location, which does not fit the pattern with 되다.

02f793a48f14a437.zh: 「-의」為所有格助詞（的），放在此處文法不通。
02f793a48f14a437.en: The possessive particle 의 means 'of' and cannot attach to the time duration here.

035697297dd94740.zh: 名詞 가방 有收音，連接名詞表示「或者」時接 이나。
035697297dd94740.en: The noun 가방 ends in a consonant, so it takes 이나 to mean or.

035697297dd94740.zh: 나 用於無收音的名詞後面，加在 가방 後面不符規則。
035697297dd94740.en: 나 is only used after nouns ending in a vowel.

035697297dd94740.zh: -거나 是接在動詞或形容詞詞幹後的連接詞尾，不可接名詞。
035697297dd94740.en: -거나 attaches to verb and adjective stems, not directly to nouns.

035697297dd94740.zh: 「에나」是「에」加「나」，用在時間、地點後面，不能把「가방」和「지갑」連成「包包或錢包」。
035697297dd94740.en: 에나 is 에 + 나, used after a time or place; it cannot join 가방 and 지갑 as "a bag or a wallet".

03a09dbb0b20595a.zh: 「-아/어 있다」與被動動詞「닫히다」結合，表示門關著的持續狀態
03a09dbb0b20595a.en: 닫혀 combines passive 닫히다 with -아/어 있다 to mean the door is closed.

03a09dbb0b20595a.zh: 「닫다」是他動詞，不能接「-아/어 있다」來表達門自身維持的狀態
03a09dbb0b20595a.en: 닫아 is active transitive; -아/어 있다 requires intransitive or passive verbs.

03a09dbb0b20595a.zh: 「닫고 있어요」表示某人正在進行關門的動作，主語不能是「문이」
03a09dbb0b20595a.en: 닫고 forms -고 있다 meaning someone is currently closing the door.

03a09dbb0b20595a.zh: 「닫히고 있어요」表示門正在被關閉的過程，而不是關著的靜止狀態
03a09dbb0b20595a.en: 닫히고 indicates the door is currently in the process of closing.

03d69fe026b31da5.en: Correct. 잃다 has a final consonant, taking -은 to modify 적 for past experience.
03d69fe026b31da5.zh: 「잃다」有收音，過去冠形詞尾接「-은」，構成「길을 잃은 적이 있다」。

03d69fe026b31da5.en: -는 marks present actions, while the experience structure requires past -(으)ㄴ.
03d69fe026b31da5.zh: 「-는」是現在式冠形詞詞尾，不能用於過去經驗「-ㄴ/은 적」。

03d69fe026b31da5.en: 잃을 is the future modifier, which does not fit past experience.
03d69fe026b31da5.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」表示未來或推測，不能表達過去的經歷。

03d69fe026b31da5.en: 잃어 cannot directly modify the noun 적 without an adnominal ending.
03d69fe026b31da5.zh: 「잃어」為連接形或非格式體句尾，無法直接修飾依存名詞「적」。

0607d5e45f89d503.zh: 動詞詞幹끝나-無收尾音，接「-ㄴ 후에」表示「在……之後」。
0607d5e45f89d503.en: The stem 끝나- ends in a vowel, so it takes -ㄴ 후에 to mean after finishing.

0607d5e45f89d503.zh: -는 후에不是標準的「在……之後」語法型態。
0607d5e45f89d503.en: -는 후에 is incorrect; after doing requires the past modifier -(으)ㄴ 후에.

0607d5e45f89d503.zh: -(으)ㄹ 후에不是表示完成後的時間接續用法。
0607d5e45f89d503.en: -(으)ㄹ 후에 is incorrect; after doing something requires -(으)ㄴ 후에.
-기 후에 is ungrammatical; the pattern is -(으)ㄴ 후에.

06acddf2dfaa985f.zh: 感嘆剛嚐到、剛得知的美味，形容詞詞幹後直接加「-네요」，故選「맛있네요」。
06acddf2dfaa985f.en: 맛있네요 correctly expresses immediate exclamation or surprise upon noticing the taste.

06acddf2dfaa985f.zh: 「-잖아요」表示「不是～嗎（理應知道）」，帶有提醒或確認語氣，不符合語境。
06acddf2dfaa985f.en: 맛있잖아요 means 'as you know, it is delicious', which does not fit an exclamation.

06acddf2dfaa985f.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」用於表達說話者的意願或詢問聽者意願，不能用於感嘆形容詞美味。
06acddf2dfaa985f.en: 맛있을래요 is unnatural; -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses intention or prompts someone to do something.

06acddf2dfaa985f.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」只能用於第一人稱動詞的承諾，不可接在形容詞後表達讚美。
06acddf2dfaa985f.en: -(으)ㄹ게요 is only used with verbs to make a promise, not with adjectives.

0735d296bc57b83d.zh: 代名詞「이건」作主題，子句主詞「제가」加時間詞「어제」，由過去定語「만든」修飾名詞。
0735d296bc57b83d.en: 이건 is the topic, followed by clause subject 제가 and adverb 어제, with past modifier 만든 describing the noun.

0764b1ca0248686e.en: Correct. Descriptive verbs without a final consonant take -ㄴ데 to express contrast.
0764b1ca0248686e.zh: 正確。形容詞無尾音接「-ㄴ데」，表示轉折對比。

0764b1ca0248686e.en: 예쁘는데 is wrong because adjectives take -(으)ㄴ데, not -는데.
예뻐는데 is ungrammatical; adjectives do not combine with -어는데.
예쁠데 expresses a hypothetical or future state and does not show contrast.
0764b1ca0248686e.zh: 「예쁠데」表示未來或推測的處所/情況，無法表達「雖然漂亮但是…」。

0a28c52f4c195635.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 지 되다」表示自某動作完成以來的時間，動詞詞幹後需接「-ㄴ」。
0a28c52f4c195635.en: The pattern V-(으)ㄴ 지 되다 requires the past-determiner ending -(으)ㄴ on the verb stem.

0a28c52f4c195635.zh: 「시작하는」是現在式冠形詞形，不能用於「-ㄴ 지 되다」句型中。
0a28c52f4c195635.en: 시작하는 is the present-tense modifier; the pattern requires the past-tense form 시작한.

0a28c52f4c195635.zh: 「시작할」是未來或推測的冠形詞形，不能表示已經發生的時間。
0a28c52f4c195635.en: 시작할 is the prospective/future modifier and cannot express elapsed time since an event.

0a28c52f4c195635.zh: 「시작했는」是錯誤的組合，修飾「지」時直接在詞幹加「-ㄴ」即可。
0a28c52f4c195635.en: 시작했는 is non-standard here; the past modifier for this grammar is formed with -ㄴ, giving 시작한.

0bc6f7b64e0276d8.en: To modify a noun in the past with a consonant-ending stem, attach 은, yielding 먹은.
0bc6f7b64e0276d8.zh: 過去修飾名詞且詞幹有收音時，接「먹은」。

0bc6f7b64e0276d8.en: 먹는 is the present modifier form, which does not match the past sentence ending.
0bc6f7b64e0276d8.zh: 「먹는」是現在修飾形，與句尾過去式不符。

0bc6f7b64e0276d8.en: 먹ㄴ is an invalid form; stems with a final consonant require 은.
0bc6f7b64e0276d8.zh: 詞尾有收音時需接은，「먹ㄴ」是錯誤的拼寫拼法。

0bc6f7b64e0276d8.en: 먹을 is the future modifier form, meaning the food I will eat.
0bc6f7b64e0276d8.zh: 「먹을」是未來修飾形，意思是「將要吃的食物」。

0d3d1de420f07aa9.zh: 「-지 마세요」是請求對方不要做的否定命令句型。
0d3d1de420f07aa9.en: -지 마세요 is the correct pattern to politely ask someone not to do something.

0d3d1de420f07aa9.zh: 「-고」用於連接動作，無法搭配 마세요 表禁止。
0d3d1de420f07aa9.en: -고 links actions or clauses and cannot precede 마세요 to forbid an action.

0d3d1de420f07aa9.zh: 「-게」表示方式或目的，無法接 마세요 表禁止。
0d3d1de420f07aa9.en: -게 forms adverbs or denotes purpose, not pairing with 마세요.

0d3d1de420f07aa9.zh: 「-기」將動詞名詞化，無法接 마세요 表禁止命令。
0d3d1de420f07aa9.en: -기 nominalizes verbs and does not connect with 마세요.

0d842470d3309369.en: The permission pattern attaches -아도 to 보- because its vowel is ㅗ.

0d842470d3309369.zh: 「보도」漏掉了連接詞尾「-아」，文法不正確。
0d842470d3309369.en: 보도 lacks the required connective vowel -아.

0d842470d3309369.zh: 請求現在的許可時，不使用過去式「-았/었어도 되다」。
0d842470d3309369.en: Past tense -았어도 is not used when asking for present permission.
The conditional ending is -(으)면; 봐면 is an incorrect form.

0e76c88017cce24c.en: Correct. 춥다 is a ㅂ-irregular adjective, changing to 추워 before vowels.
0e76c88017cce24c.zh: 「춥다」為ㅂ不規則形容詞，遇到母音變為「추워」，正確。

0e76c88017cce24c.en: 춥다 is a ㅂ-irregular stem, so it does not conjugate as 춥어.
The pattern requires -아/어지다; you cannot attach -지다 directly to 춥-.
0e76c88017cce24c.zh: 接「-아/어지다」時必須帶有母音連接詞，不能直接加「-지다」。

0e76c88017cce24c.en: Past tense -었- attaches to -지다 at the end, not to the stem 추웠-.
0e76c88017cce24c.zh: 過去式標記「-었-」應加在後方的「지다」，而非前方的形容詞詞幹。

0f813ac9973034f7.zh: 時間「내일부터」和「매일」放在前面，一起修飾「운동하기로 했어요」。
0f813ac9973034f7.en: The time words 내일부터 and 매일 come first and both go with 운동하기로 했어요.

10c25767c6b14fef.zh: 名詞 교통사고 後面直接接 때문에 表示「因為…」。
10c25767c6b14fef.en: The noun 교통사고 takes 때문에 directly to mean because of.

10c25767c6b14fef.zh: -기 때문에 前面必須接動詞或形容詞詞幹，不能直接接名詞。
10c25767c6b14fef.en: -기 때문에 must attach to a verb or adjective stem, not directly to a noun.

10c25767c6b14fef.zh: 「이기 때문」少了「에」，句子接不下去；名詞表示原因直接說「교통사고 때문에」。
10c25767c6b14fef.en: 이기 때문 lacks 에 and cannot link to the rest; with a noun, the cause is simply 교통사고 때문에.

10c25767c6b14fef.zh: -를 위해서 表示「為了…」，意思不合且不能接交通事故。
10c25767c6b14fef.en: 를 위해서 means for the sake of, which does not make sense with traffic accidents.

10e5b84feec0d529.en: When 멀다 connects to -네요, the irregular ㄹ drops before ㄴ, correctly making 머네요.
멀네요 incorrectly keeps the stem-final ㄹ, which must drop before ㄴ.
멀으네요 is incorrect because -네요 connects directly without inserting the vowel 으.
10e5b84feec0d529.zh: 「-네요」直接接於語幹，不能加「-으-」，「멀으네요」為錯誤形態。

10e5b84feec0d529.en: 멀어네요 is grammatically incorrect; -네요 attaches to the basic stem, not to an -어 form.
10e5b84feec0d529.zh: 「-네요」並非接在陽性/陰性母音型詞尾後，「멀어네요」為非正規形態。

11018ef92f85feda.en: The adjective 맛있다 attaches -게 directly to the stem to form delicious-ly.
11018ef92f85feda.zh: 形容詞「맛있다」幹接「-게」轉為副詞，意為「美味地」。

11018ef92f85feda.en: 맛있어게 is ungrammatical; -게 attaches directly to the stem 맛있-.
11018ef92f85feda.zh: 「-게」直接加在形容詞詞幹後，不需先加「-어」。

11018ef92f85feda.en: 맛있는 is a noun-modifying adjective form, not an adverb modifying a verb.
11018ef92f85feda.zh: 「맛있는」是修飾名詞的冠形詞形，後面不能直接接動詞。

11018ef92f85feda.en: 맛있어서 expresses a reason (because it is delicious), which does not fit.
11018ef92f85feda.zh: 「맛있어서」表示原因（因為好吃），不符合祝賀用餐的語境。

118e5bd11322d476.en: Nouns connect directly to 후에 to mean after that event or time.
118e5bd11322d476.zh: 名詞後面直接接「후에」，表示在某事件或時間之後。

118e5bd11322d476.en: The ending 은 후에 attaches to verb stems with a final consonant, not nouns.
118e5bd11322d476.zh: 「은 후에」用於有收音的動詞詞幹，不能直接接在名詞後面。

118e5bd11322d476.en: In Korean, nouns connect directly to 후에 without the possessive particle 의.
118e5bd11322d476.zh: 韓語中名詞接「후에」時不加所有格助詞「의」。

118e5bd11322d476.en: The form 기 후에 is ungrammatical in Korean.
118e5bd11322d476.zh: 「기 후에」不是正確的韓語語法表達方式。

16c58b2363fff643.zh: 動詞「일하다」接「-게 되다」表示受到外部原因決定將去首爾工作
16c58b2363fff643.en: 일하게 됐어요 correctly uses -게 되다 to express an externally decided situation.

16c58b2363fff643.zh: 「-아/어지다」接形容詞表示狀態變化，不能直接接在動詞「일하다」上
16c58b2363fff643.en: 일해졌어요 incorrectly applies adjective change pattern -아/어지다 to an action verb.

16c58b2363fff643.zh: 「-게 하다」表示使動或指示別人去做，意思是「讓我去工作」而不是自己將去
16c58b2363fff643.en: 일하게 했어요 means made someone work, which changes the intended meaning.

16c58b2363fff643.zh: 「-고 되다」不是正確的文法形式，表示轉變必須用「-게 되다」
16c58b2363fff643.en: 일하고 됐어요 is ungrammatical; the pattern requires -게 되다.

192cf3a76ad976b2.en: The stem 있- ends in a consonant, so it takes 으면 for if.
192cf3a76ad976b2.zh: 詞幹「있-」有終聲收音，接「으면」表示條件「如果」。

192cf3a76ad976b2.en: 면 attaches only to stems ending in a vowel or ㄹ.
192cf3a76ad976b2.zh: 「면」只能接在無收音或收音為「ㄹ」的詞幹後。

192cf3a76ad976b2.en: 어서 expresses cause or sequence, meaning because or and then.
192cf3a76ad976b2.zh: 「어서」表示原因或順序「因為有時間」，不表假設條件。

192cf3a76ad976b2.en: 지만 expresses contrast meaning although, which does not fit here.
192cf3a76ad976b2.zh: 「지만」表示轉折「雖然有時間」，不符合句意。

19aa085624f8e4ff.en: The fixed pattern -(으)면 안 돼요 expresses prohibition, meaning you must not.
19aa085624f8e4ff.zh: 「-(으)면 안 돼요」是固定禁止句型，表示「不能／不可以」。

19aa085624f8e4ff.en: Korean does not use 못 돼요 to forbid actions; 안 돼요 is required.
19aa085624f8e4ff.zh: 韓語中表達禁止時不使用「못 돼요」，這是錯誤的搭配。

19aa085624f8e4ff.en: The phrase 쓰면 안 해요 is unnatural and does not mean one cannot use it.
19aa085624f8e4ff.zh: 「쓰면 안 해요」語法不自然，無法表達「不可使用」的禁止含義。

19aa085624f8e4ff.en: The word 없어요 means does not exist/have, not used after -(으)면 for prohibition.
19aa085624f8e4ff.zh: 「없어요」表示不存在或沒有，不能接在「-(으)면」後表達禁止。

19fef7c05899108e.en: 입고 correctly pairs with 있다 via -고 있다 to describe the ongoing state of wearing clothing.
19fef7c05899108e.zh: 穿戴動詞如「입다」接「-고 있다」表示穿在身上的持續狀態，符合句意。

19fef7c05899108e.en: 입어 있다 is unnatural because clothing verbs express the worn state using -고 있다.
19fef7c05899108e.zh: 「입다」是穿著動詞，表達「穿著」的狀態習慣用「-고 있다」而非「-어 있다」。

19fef7c05899108e.en: 입혀 is the causative form meaning 'to dress someone', which doesn't fit here.
19fef7c05899108e.zh: 「입히다」是使役動詞「給…穿上」，語法與語意均不符合。

19fef7c05899108e.en: 입으려 indicates intention ('intending to wear'), not the state of currently wearing it.
19fef7c05899108e.zh: 「입으려」表示意圖（想要穿），不能與「있어요」直接搭配。

1a75cd332d27f62f.zh: 하다結尾形容詞接-아서/어서規則變為「해서」，表原因。
1a75cd332d27f62f.en: Verbs or adjectives ending in 하다 change to 해서 with -아서/어서 to express cause.

1a75cd332d27f62f.zh: 表原因的-아서/어서前方不可使用過去式「았/었」。
1a75cd332d27f62f.en: The causal ending -아서/어서 cannot follow the past tense suffix 았/었.
하다 contracts to 해서 with -여서, making 하어서 an incorrect form.

1a75cd332d27f62f.zh: 「피곤하면」表示「如果累的話」，非敘述昨日既成的原因。
1a75cd332d27f62f.en: 피곤하면 means if one is tired, which is a condition rather than a past reason.

1b486307b0dfeecf.zh: 主詞저는在首，形容詞조용한修飾受詞카페를，最後放謂語좋아해요。
1b486307b0dfeecf.en: Subject 저는 starts the sentence, followed by the modifier 조용한 before object 카페를 and verb 좋아해요.

1bfe3a64a88d37ac.en: The stem 찍- ends in a consonant (batchim), so it takes -으려고 to express intention.
1bfe3a64a88d37ac.zh: 動詞「찍다」詞幹有收音，意圖接尾詞應接「-으려고」。

1bfe3a64a88d37ac.en: -러고 is a misspelled form; the grammar suffix is -(으)려고.
1bfe3a64a88d37ac.zh: 韓語中無「-러고」這種形態，意圖文法為「-(으)려고」。

1bfe3a64a88d37ac.en: When the stem ends in a consonant, -으- is required before -려고.
1bfe3a64a88d37ac.zh: 有收音的動詞詞幹後不能直接接「-려고」，必須加「-으-」。

1bfe3a64a88d37ac.en: Past tense markers like -었- cannot be used before -(으)려고.
1bfe3a64a88d37ac.zh: 表示目的與意圖的「-(으)려고」前不可加過去時制「-었-」。

1c60b7b737aa350d.zh: 「-지 마세요」是禮貌勸阻對方的正確否定命令型。
1c60b7b737aa350d.en: -지 마세요 is the correct honorific pattern for polite negative commands.

1c60b7b737aa350d.zh: 「-지 못하세요」表示能力上無法做到，非否定命令。
1c60b7b737aa350d.en: -지 못하세요 implies an inability to do something, not a polite request not to.

1c60b7b737aa350d.zh: 없으세요 是「沒有」的敬語，無法接在 -지 後表命令。
1c60b7b737aa350d.en: 없으세요 means do not have and cannot follow -지 to make a command.

1c60b7b737aa350d.zh: 말다 接敬語 -(으)세요 時 ㄹ 脫落，正確為 마세요。
1c60b7b737aa350d.en: 말다 irregular stems drop ㄹ before -(으)세요, yielding 마세요, not 말아세요.

1c7a33303e6be15f.zh: 時間副詞「내일은」接副詞「일찍」，接動詞連用形「일어나야」與「해요」表示義務。
1c7a33303e6be15f.en: The topic 내일은 is followed by adverb 일찍, leading into the obligation construction 일어나야 해요.

1d51a6595d7c2e51.zh: 「듣다」為「ㄷ」不規則動詞，遇到母音變為「ㄹ」，過去定語為「들은」。
1d51a6595d7c2e51.en: 들은 correctly applies the ㄷ-irregular rule (ㄷ changes to ㄹ before a vowel) with past -(으)ㄴ.

1d51a6595d7c2e51.zh: 「듣은」未套用「ㄷ」不規則變化，是不正確的拼寫。
1d51a6595d7c2e51.en: 듣은 fails to apply the irregular ㄷ-to-ㄹ sound change before the vowel.

1d51a6595d7c2e51.zh: 「듣는」是現在式定語，與過去時間詞「지난주」（上週）不符。
1d51a6595d7c2e51.en: 듣는 is the present tense modifier, which clashes with the past time 지난주.

1d51a6595d7c2e51.zh: 「들는」是不合文法的形式，「-는」前「ㄷ」不會變成「ㄹ」。
1d51a6595d7c2e51.en: 들는 is ungrammatical; ㄷ only changes to ㄹ before vowels, not before 는.

207628ad550c368c.en: The pattern -(으)ㄴ 지 되다 requires the past noun-modifying ending -(으)ㄴ, making 배운 correct.
207628ad550c368c.zh: 表示做某事過了多久，動詞需用過去冠形詞「-(으)ㄴ」接「배운」。

207628ad550c368c.en: 배우는 is the present-tense modifier and cannot combine with 지 되다.
207628ad550c368c.zh: 「배우는」為現在式修飾形，不能搭配表示已過時間的「지 되다」。

207628ad550c368c.en: 배울 is the future-tense modifier, which cannot express elapsed time from the past.
207628ad550c368c.zh: 「배울」是未來式修飾形，不能用來計算自過去開始歷時多久。

207628ad550c368c.en: 배워 is an informal connector form and cannot grammatically modify the bound noun 지.
207628ad550c368c.zh: 「배워」是動詞非格式體語幹，不能直接修飾名詞「지」。

221219682294f7f2.en: 살게 correctly attaches -게 to the stem of 살다 to express ending up living somewhere due to circumstances.
221219682294f7f2.zh: 「-게 되다」接動詞詞幹「살-」，表示因為外部因素而「落得/變成…住」。

221219682294f7f2.en: 살아 does not fit the grammatical pattern -게 되다, which requires the suffix -게.
221219682294f7f2.zh: 「살아」是「살다」的連接形，不能與「되다」結合成「-게 되다」句型。

221219682294f7f2.en: 사게 comes from the verb 사다 (to buy), changing the meaning to 'ended up buying'.
221219682294f7f2.zh: 「사게」是「사다（買）」的接續形，意思會變成「變得去買」。

221219682294f7f2.en: 살도록 expresses degree or purpose ('so that I live'), not the resulting outcome construction.
221219682294f7f2.zh: 「살도록」表示目的或程度（為了生活/讓…住），無法與「됐어요」搭配形成此句型。

22b6707d3ef61ff8.en: Action verbs take -는 in the present modifier form, correctly producing 오는 것 같다.
22b6707d3ef61ff8.zh: 動詞「오다」的現在式定語形為「-는」，構成「오는 것 같다」。

22b6707d3ef61ff8.en: The modifier suffix -는 attaches to the verb stem 오-, not to conjugated forms like 와-.
22b6707d3ef61ff8.zh: 定語詞尾「-는」直接接在詞幹「오-」後，非接在過去式「와-」後。

22b6707d3ef61ff8.en: 온는 is a misspelled form; the present modifier for 오다 is simply 오는.
22b6707d3ef61ff8.zh: 「온는」拼寫錯誤，動詞現在定語直接加「-는」成「오는」。

22b6707d3ef61ff8.en: 오은 is grammatically incorrect because verbs take -는, not -은, to modify nouns in the present tense.
22b6707d3ef61ff8.zh: 「오은」形態錯誤，動詞現在定語用「-는」而非「-은」。

2301c9723e0684ff.zh: 動詞「오다」詞幹無收音，接「-ㄹ게요」形成「올게요」，表示說話者的承諾。
2301c9723e0684ff.en: 오다 ends in a vowel, so adding -ㄹ게요 forms 올게요 to promise a future action.

2301c9723e0684ff.zh: 無收音動詞詞幹直接接「-ㄹ게요」，不能接「-을게요」，「오을게요」錯誤。
2301c9723e0684ff.en: Vowel-stem verbs take -ㄹ게요 directly, making 오을게요 grammatically wrong.

2301c9723e0684ff.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」的拼寫是「게요」，不可寫成發音相近的「께요」。
2301c9723e0684ff.en: The correct grammatical orthography is -ㄹ게요; 올께요 is a spelling mistake.

2301c9723e0684ff.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」表示承諾要做的事，不能與過去時態「-았-」合用。
2301c9723e0684ff.en: -(으)ㄹ게요 expresses speaker's future promise, so it cannot combine with past-tense 왔-.

2315b22204a854e5.zh: 動詞詞幹加「-기 전에」表示「在去……之前」。
2315b22204a854e5.en: Attaching -기 전에 to the verb stem 가- correctly expresses before going.

2315b22204a854e5.zh: 表示在做某事之前不能用過去定語「간 전에」。
2315b22204a854e5.en: 간 전에 is ungrammatical; the correct grammar pattern is -기 전에.

2315b22204a854e5.zh: 表示「在……之後」應用-(으)ㄴ 후에，無「-기 후에」用法。
2315b22204a854e5.en: -기 후에 is incorrect; after doing requires -(으)ㄴ 후에.

2315b22204a854e5.zh: 「-기 전에」前面不能使用過去時制「-았-」。
2315b22204a854e5.en: -기 전에 attaches to the basic stem, never using past tense -았-.

26b8aca0aaca680d.zh: 地點「책상 위에」放在句首，主語「꽃이」接被動狀態「놓여 있어요」
26b8aca0aaca680d.en: The location 책상 위에 comes first, followed by subject 꽃이 and the resulting state 놓여 있어요.

284f661402f078b3.en: Correct. Verb stems take -거나 directly to express 'or' between actions.
284f661402f078b3.zh: 正確。動詞詞幹直接接「-거나」表示「或者」。

284f661402f078b3.en: 봐거나 incorrectly uses the informal conjugated stem 봐-.
284f661402f078b3.zh: 「봐거나」錯誤地使用了非格式體詞幹「봐-」。

284f661402f078b3.en: 보나 uses -나, which attaches to nouns or functions differently with verbs; use -거나.
284f661402f078b3.zh: 「보나」通常用於名詞（或作為「-나」文法），動詞選擇應接「-거나」。

284f661402f078b3.en: 보면서 means 'while watching', which changes the meaning from choosing between actions to doing both at once.
284f661402f078b3.zh: 「보면서」表示「一邊看一邊…」，句意並非同時看電影與看書。

2862ec3c8540d5a1.zh: 「전화하다」無收音，接「-ㄹ게요」形成「전화할게요」，表示承諾明天再打。
2862ec3c8540d5a1.en: 전화하다 ends in a vowel, combining with -ㄹ게요 to promise 전화할게요.

2862ec3c8540d5a1.zh: 「전화할게요」拼寫必須為「게요」，不可依照口語濃音發音寫成「께요」。
2862ec3c8540d5a1.en: Even though it sounds like 께요, standard orthography requires 전화할게요.

2862ec3c8540d5a1.zh: 母音結尾的詞幹接「-ㄹ게요」，不需要且不能插入「을」，型態錯誤。
2862ec3c8540d5a1.en: Stems ending in a vowel take -ㄹ게요 directly, making 전화하을게요 incorrect.

2862ec3c8540d5a1.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」表達對未來的承諾，不能與過去式「-았/었-」組合。
2862ec3c8540d5a1.en: Past tense cannot attach to -(으)ㄹ게요, making 전화했을게요 impossible here.

29aa776809730736.zh: 動詞「열다」以 ㄹ 收音結尾，接「-(으)ㄹ게요」時直接加「게요」，成「열게요」。
29aa776809730736.en: 열다 has a ㄹ final consonant, so it combines directly with 게요 to form 열게요.

29aa776809730736.zh: 「열다」底下的收音為 ㄹ，不可再加上「을게요」，「열을게요」型態錯誤。
29aa776809730736.en: Stems ending in ㄹ do not take 을게요; 열을게요 is an incorrect conjugation.

29aa776809730736.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」標準拼寫為「게요」，雖然發音偏濃音，但不能寫成「께요」。
29aa776809730736.en: Although pronounced with a tense consonant, the standard spelling is 게요, not 께요.

29aa776809730736.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」表示說話者未來的承諾，不能與過去式「-았/었-」連用。
29aa776809730736.en: -(으)ㄹ게요 makes a promise about a future action, so it cannot attach to the past tense.

2a7d127d886ee071.en: Correct. The past modifier form of 보다 is 본 before 적이 있다.
2a7d127d886ee071.zh: 過去經驗句型需用過去冠形詞「-(으)ㄴ」，「보다」接「-ㄴ」成「본」。

2a7d127d886ee071.en: -는 is the present noun-modifying ending, but experience requires -(으)ㄴ.
2a7d127d886ee071.zh: 「-는」為現在式修飾語，經驗句型需使用過去式修飾語「-(으)ㄴ」。

2a7d127d886ee071.en: 볼 indicates future or hypothetical actions, not past experiences.
2a7d127d886ee071.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」為未來式修飾語，不能用於表達過去經驗。

2a7d127d886ee071.en: 봐 is an informal sentence ending and cannot modify 적 directly.
2a7d127d886ee071.zh: 「봐」為非敬語句尾或連接形式，不能直接修飾名詞「적」。

2ab29a117432daf4.zh: 名詞 감기 接 때문에 表示原因，接著受詞目的地 회사에，副詞 못 修飾動詞 갔어요。
2ab29a117432daf4.en: The noun 감기 takes 때문에 for cause, followed by destination 회사에 and negative adverb 못 before 갔어요.

2cda558e8be2c0b7.zh: 「오다」語幹無收音接「-(으)ㄹ 때」，表示「下雨的時候」。
2cda558e8be2c0b7.en: 비가 올 correctly attaches -(으)ㄹ 때 to the vowel stem 오- to mean when it rains.

2cda558e8be2c0b7.zh: 「비가 오는」是現在式修飾形，不能直接與表示「時候」的句型「때」搭配。
2cda558e8be2c0b7.en: 비가 오는 is the present modifier; 때 typically takes the -(으)ㄹ ending.

2cda558e8be2c0b7.zh: 「비가 온」是過去式修飾形，在此不符合對未來下雨時的提醒語境。
2cda558e8be2c0b7.en: 비가 온 is a past modifier and does not match this general or future reminder.

2cda558e8be2c0b7.zh: 「비가 와」是口語終結詞尾，不能直接接名詞「때」。
2cda558e8be2c0b7.en: 비가 와 is an informal sentence ending and cannot directly modify 때.

2d4cc834244c7468.en: Adjectives ending in 있다 take 는 when modifying a noun.
2d4cc834244c7468.zh: 以「있다」結尾的形容詞，修飾名詞時一律加「-는」。

2d4cc834244c7468.en: 있다-type adjectives must take 는, not 은.
맛있- ends with ㅆ, so a bare ㄴ cannot attach beneath it.
2d4cc834244c7468.zh: 詞幹有收音「ㅆ」，無法直接在下方塞入子音「ㄴ」。

2d4cc834244c7468.en: 맛있어 is an informal clause ending, not an adnominal modifier.
2d4cc834244c7468.zh: 「맛있어」是句子終結形態，無法直接修飾後面的名詞。

2ecfff93b497a243.en: The stem 피우- ends in a vowel, so it takes -면 안 돼요 to express prohibition.
2ecfff93b497a243.zh: 動詞「피우다」詞幹無收音，接「-면 안 돼요」表示禁止。

2ecfff93b497a243.en: The suffix -으면 is used after stems ending in a consonant, not after vowels.
2ecfff93b497a243.zh: 「-으면」用於詞幹末尾有收音的動詞，不能接在無收音的「피우-」後。

2ecfff93b497a243.en: The standard pattern for prohibition is -(으)면 안 되다, not -어도 안 돼요.
2ecfff93b497a243.zh: 「-어도 안 돼요」不是標準禁止句型，禁止應使用「-(으)면 안 되다」。

2ecfff93b497a243.en: The connective -고 expresses listing or sequence, not prohibition with 안 돼요.
2ecfff93b497a243.zh: 「-고」表示並列或接續，不能與「안 돼요」組成禁止句型。

325a5390281c6f01.zh: 冠形詞子句「어제 본」修飾「영화」，後接過去確認句尾「재미있었죠」。
325a5390281c6f01.en: The relative clause 어제 본 modifies 영화, which serves as the subject before the predicate 재미있었죠.

346b972d37d98509.zh: 動詞現在式無論有無收音，皆接「-는데」提供背景或對比。
346b972d37d98509.en: Action verbs in present tense take -는데 regardless of final consonants to set contrast.

346b972d37d98509.zh: 「-ㄴ데」用於無收音的形容詞，動詞現在式應用 -는데。
346b972d37d98509.en: -ㄴ데 attaches to vowel-ending adjectives; action verbs take -는데.

346b972d37d98509.zh: 「-은데」用於有收音的形容詞，動詞現在式接 -는데。
346b972d37d98509.en: -은데 attaches to consonant-ending adjectives; action verbs require -는데.

346b972d37d98509.zh: 「-던데」表示回想過去經歷的情況，此處僅為一般對比。
346b972d37d98509.en: -던데 expresses recollection of a past observation, which is not intended here.

390c3aa78f5fd92f.en: 자는 is the present modifier needed before 동안(에) to mean while the baby sleeps.
390c3aa78f5fd92f.zh: 動詞接「-는 동안(에)」表示在…期間，修飾名詞用「자는」。

390c3aa78f5fd92f.en: 잔 is the past modifier, which does not correctly pair with 동안 for a duration.
390c3aa78f5fd92f.zh: 「잔」是過去形修飾，不能與表示一段持續時間的동안搭配。

390c3aa78f5fd92f.en: 잘 is the future modifier, which conflicts with the completed past action in the main clause.
390c3aa78f5fd92f.zh: 「잘」是將來形修飾，與後文已完成的打掃過去時態不符。

390c3aa78f5fd92f.en: 자고 is a connective ending meaning and, so it cannot modify the noun 동안.
390c3aa78f5fd92f.zh: 「자고」是連接詞尾，不能直接修飾後面的名詞동안。

393f9b9d5f4711e5.zh: 「입다」詞幹母音為ㅣ，嘗試句型接「-어 보다」。
393f9b9d5f4711e5.en: The stem vowel of 입다 is ㅣ, so it takes -어 보다 to mean try on.
Because the stem vowel is not ㅏ or ㅗ, -아 cannot attach.

393f9b9d5f4711e5.zh: 「-기」是名詞形字尾，不能與「보세요」組合表示嘗試。
393f9b9d5f4711e5.en: The nominalizer -기 cannot combine with 보세요 to express trying.

393f9b9d5f4711e5.zh: 「-(으)면」表示條件「如果」，不符合「試穿」的語意。
393f9b9d5f4711e5.en: The conditional -(으)면 means if, not try doing.

3982bf9eeabddcf4.zh: 條件句「한국에 가면」接受詞「떡볶이를」，再接動詞「먹어」。
3982bf9eeabddcf4.en: The conditional clause 한국에 가면 leads to the object 떡볶이를 and verb 먹어 before 보세요.

3fa82dc00353c802.en: 가다 combines with -아서 and contracts naturally to 가서.
가다 has a bright vowel, so it takes -아서, not -어서.
Past tense markers like -았- cannot attach before -어서.
가지만 expresses contrast (I go, but...), which does not fit.
3fa82dc00353c802.zh: 「가지만」表示轉折「雖然去……但是」，意思不合。

3fb51066056f8788.en: 없는 is correct because 없다 takes the present modifier -는 before 동안.
3fb51066056f8788.zh: 存在詞없다修飾名詞동안時，必須接「-는」，作「없는」。

3fb51066056f8788.en: 없은 is ungrammatical; 없다 takes -는, not -은, when modifying nouns.
3fb51066056f8788.zh: 「없은」為錯誤形態，없다修飾名詞時不接-은，要接-는。

3fb51066056f8788.en: 없을 is a future modifier and does not fit the standard clause 제가 없는 동안.
3fb51066056f8788.zh: 「없을」表推測或未來，但此處指特定離開的期間，應用없는。

3fb51066056f8788.en: 없던 expresses past recollection and does not fit when asking for a favor.
3fb51066056f8788.zh: 「없던」表過去回想，不適合用在向對方提出請求的句子中。

40fca20c35c573a1.zh: 表達感謝的原由時，慣用「-아/어 주셔서 감사합니다」。
40fca20c35c573a1.en: -아/어 주셔서 감사합니다 is the natural, polite pattern used to thank someone for help.

40fca20c35c573a1.zh: 向對方道謝的原因慣用-아서/어서，用-(으)니까顯得不夠自然謙遜。
40fca20c35c573a1.en: -(으)니까 sounds abrupt or overly assertive when expressing gratitude to someone.
-아서/어서 cannot be used with the past tense marker 었.

40fca20c35c573a1.zh: 「-지만」表示轉折「雖然……但是」，與道謝句意矛盾。
40fca20c35c573a1.en: -지만 means although or but, which contradicts giving thanks.

425c0de47e9e2e5f.zh: 以「하다」結尾的形容詞變為「해지다」，過去式正確縮約為「건강해졌어요」
425c0de47e9e2e5f.en: 건강해졌어요 correctly conjugates the 하다 adjective with -아/어지다 in the past tense.

425c0de47e9e2e5f.zh: 「하다」後接「-아/어지다」時應變成「해지다」，不能直接寫成「하졌다」
425c0de47e9e2e5f.en: 건강하졌어요 is a misspelling; 하다 forms combine into 해졌어요.

425c0de47e9e2e5f.zh: 「-게 지다」不是合法的文法結合形式，必須用「-아/어지다」
「지다」與過去式詞尾結合時必須縮約為「졌어요」，不可展開寫「지었어요」
425c0de47e9e2e5f.en: 건강해지었어요 is non-standard; 지- and -었- must contract to 졌어요.

436c5091b0876160.zh: 主語「선생님은」接賓語「한국어를」，副詞「정말」修飾句尾感嘆動詞「잘하시네요」。
436c5091b0876160.en: Subject 선생님은 comes first, object 한국어를 next, and adverb 정말 modifies the verb 잘하시네요.

444e35df49205c7e.en: 잘하시네요 expresses spontaneous admiration or surprise at noticing how well they speak Korean.
444e35df49205c7e.zh: 「잘하시네요」表示當下察覺並感嘆對方韓語說得好，符合語境。

444e35df49205c7e.en: 잘하시잖아요 implies you're reminding them of a fact ('as you know, you speak well'), not expressing fresh surprise.
444e35df49205c7e.zh: 「잘하시잖아요」帶有「你明明很擅長啊」的提醒語氣，不合驚嘆語境。

444e35df49205c7e.en: 잘하시거든요 explains a reason or gives background info the listener didn't know, which doesn't fit here.
444e35df49205c7e.zh: 「잘하시거든요」用於說明聽者不知道的事實或理由，此處不適用。

444e35df49205c7e.en: 잘하실래요 asks about the listener's intention or willingness, which makes no sense in this context.
444e35df49205c7e.zh: 「잘하실래요」是詢問對方的意願或打算，意思變成「您要說得好嗎」。

44a3fb52c8bb323b.en: 오다 combined with -아서 contracts correctly to 와서.
The past tense suffix -았- cannot be used before -어서.
44a3fb52c8bb323b.zh: 表示原因的「-아서/어서」前面不能加過去式「-았-」。

44a3fb52c8bb323b.en: 오아서 is uncontracted; in Korean, 오- + -아서 must contract to 와서.
오고 merely connects two facts without showing cause and effect.
44a3fb52c8bb323b.zh: 「오고」表示單純並列，無法表達因果關係。

47096d0181933129.zh: 先看韓劇「한국 드라마를 보고」，引發了喜歡韓語的轉變「한국어를 좋아하게」
47096d0181933129.en: 한국 드라마를 보고 describes the prior action leading to liking Korean, ending with 좋아하게 before 됐어요.

476ffb78e8047143.en: 걸려 from passive 걸리다 combines with -어 있다 to express the state of hanging on the wall.
476ffb78e8047143.zh: 被動詞「걸리다」接「-어 있다」，表示照片「掛著」的結果狀態。

476ffb78e8047143.en: 걸고 would imply someone is currently in the act of hanging something up.
476ffb78e8047143.zh: 「걸고 있다」表示主動動作正在進行（正在掛），不符合物品狀態的描繪。

476ffb78e8047143.en: 걸어 from transitive 걸다 does not naturally take -어 있다 to describe a hanging object.
476ffb78e8047143.zh: 「걸다」為他動詞，一般不與「-어 있다」直接連用描述物體自身狀態。

476ffb78e8047143.en: 걸리게 forms an adverbial phrase ('so that it hangs'), which cannot complete this construction.
476ffb78e8047143.zh: 「걸리게」為副詞形（使之被掛上），不能直接接「있어요」表示狀態。

4899655473f883af.zh: 名詞「동생」有收音，確認時接「-(이)죠」的形式為「이죠」。
4899655473f883af.en: The noun 동생 has a final consonant, so it takes 이죠 for confirmation.

4899655473f883af.zh: 「-죠」只能接在沒有收音的名詞後面。
4899655473f883af.en: -죠 directly attaches only to nouns ending in a vowel.

4899655473f883af.zh: 「동생」有收音，若用長型應為「이지요」，不能直接接「지요」。
4899655473f883af.en: With a consonant-ending noun, the full form is 이지요, not plain 지요.

4899655473f883af.zh: 名詞結尾無「-이에죠」這種組合形式。
4899655473f883af.en: 이에죠 is an ungrammatical combination of endings.

48a59844147014ca.en: The stem 먹- ends in a consonant, so it takes 을 때, forming 먹을.
48a59844147014ca.zh: 動詞詞幹有收音時，接을 때形成「먹을」。

48a59844147014ca.en: Stems with a final consonant require the syllable 을; 먹ㄹ is an impossible spelling.
48a59844147014ca.zh: 詞幹有收音時必須加을，「먹ㄹ」是錯誤拼寫。

48a59844147014ca.en: 먹는 is the standard present noun modifier, not used with 때.
48a59844147014ca.zh: 「먹는」是名詞修飾形，不能與表示「…時」的때搭配。

48a59844147014ca.en: 먹어 is an informal ending or connector and cannot directly precede 때.
48a59844147014ca.zh: 「먹어」是非正式句尾或連接形，不能直接加때。

48adb395fbb57103.en: Correct. -(으)ㄹ 줄 모르다 is the set phrase for not knowing how to do something.
48adb395fbb57103.zh: 表示「不會做某事」時，固定搭配「-(으)ㄹ 줄 모르다」。

48adb395fbb57103.en: 없어요 combines with -(으)ㄹ 수, not 줄, to mean cannot do something.
48adb395fbb57103.zh: 「줄」後面不直接搭配「없어요」來表示不會某種技能。

48adb395fbb57103.en: 못해요 expresses inability on its own and does not follow the noun 줄.
48adb395fbb57103.zh: 表達能力句型需用「모르다」，「줄 못해요」非標準用法。

48adb395fbb57103.en: 안 돼요 expresses prohibition or failure, not the lack of knowing how.
48adb395fbb57103.zh: 「줄 안 돼요」不是表示缺乏技能的自然韓語句型。

4a3750eb604a03be.zh: 時間狀語「내일은」放句首，接著主語「날씨가」，接形容詞推測型「좋을 것 같다」。
4a3750eb604a03be.en: Topic 내일은 comes first, then subject 날씨가, followed by future/guess modifier 좋을 with 것 같아요.

4acfafa5adea1cb5.zh: 맵다為ㅂ不規則形容詞，遇母音變為우，接ㄴ修飾名詞成「매운」。
4acfafa5adea1cb5.en: 맵다 is a ㅂ-irregular adjective: ㅂ changes to 우, becoming 매운 before a noun.

4acfafa5adea1cb5.zh: 맵다遇母音語尾時ㅂ會脫落變為우，不可直接加「은」。
4acfafa5adea1cb5.en: The ㅂ irregular stem cannot simply take 은; 맵은 is incorrect.

4acfafa5adea1cb5.zh: 形容詞修飾名詞現在式不使用「-는」，且맵다為不規則變化。
4acfafa5adea1cb5.en: Adjectives use -(으)ㄴ rather than -는 to modify nouns in the present.

4acfafa5adea1cb5.zh: 「매워」為非敬語句末終結形，不能直接修飾後面的名詞。
4acfafa5adea1cb5.en: 매워 is a sentence ending form and cannot modify a noun directly.

4c62041c08349c51.zh: 「-기 전에」接在動詞詞幹後表示「在……之前」。
4c62041c08349c51.en: -기 전에 attaches directly to the verb stem 오- to mean before coming.

4c62041c08349c51.zh: 「온」是過去定語形，不能與「전에」搭配表「在做……之前」。
4c62041c08349c51.en: 온 is a past noun-modifying form and does not pair with 전에 here.

4c62041c08349c51.zh: 「오는」是現在定語形，表示「在做……之前」慣用「-기 전에」。
4c62041c08349c51.en: 오는 is a present modifier; the set pattern for before is -기 전에.
-기 전에 does not take past tense markers like -았/었-.

4c876656e41276be.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 줄 모르다」是固定句型，表示不會或不懂某種技能。
4c876656e41276be.en: The fixed construction -(으)ㄹ 줄 모르다 means to not know how to do something.

4c876656e41276be.zh: 「알다」的否定不能用「못 알아요」，必須使用「몰라요」。
4c876656e41276be.en: The verb 알다 cannot be negated with 못; its antonym 모르다 must be used.

4c876656e41276be.zh: 「알다」的否定不能用「안 알아요」，必須使用「몰라요」。
4c876656e41276be.en: 알다 cannot be negated with 안; Korean requires the dedicated negative verb 모르다.

4c876656e41276be.zh: 「없어요」表示不存在，不能與「-(으)ㄹ 줄」搭配表示不會某項技能。
4c876656e41276be.en: 없어요 expresses non-existence or lack of possession, not lack of ability or knowledge.

4ca94fff146080be.en: 모르다 ends in a vowel, so adding 면 yields 모르면.
모르- ends in a vowel, so 으면 cannot attach to it.
몰라 is an inflected form and cannot directly take 면.
There is no grammatical ending such as -고면 in Korean.
4ca94fff146080be.zh: 韓語中沒有「-고면」這種條件接續詞尾。

4df056d0b15f291c.en: Correct. -기로 했어요 denotes making a personal decision to quit.
4df056d0b15f291c.zh: 表示個人下定決心戒酒，使用「-기로 했어요」。

4df056d0b15f291c.en: 됐어요 makes it sound like an external arrangement rather than a personal resolution.
4df056d0b15f291c.zh: 「-기로 됐어요」多表示外在決定或安排的結果，非主動決心。

4df056d0b15f291c.en: 있어요 does not form the grammar pattern for making decisions with -기로.
4df056d0b15f291c.zh: 韓語中沒有「-기로 있어요」這種固定搭配。

4df056d0b15f291c.en: 졌어요 (from 지다) does not combine with -기로 to express a decision.

4df850141a83c328.zh: 時間어제置首，受詞친구를接만나서表先見面，再接같이修飾吃晚餐。
4df850141a83c328.en: Time word 어제 starts the clause, 친구를 만나서 expresses the first action, and 같이 modifies the subsequent dinner.

5237fd67b3496646.zh: 後句為提議句-(으)ㅂ시다，前句表原因須用「많으니까」。
5237fd67b3496646.en: The ending -(으)ㅂ시다 is a suggestion, so the reason must use 많으니까.
-아서 cannot be followed by suggestions like 갑시다.
The stem 많다 ends with a consonant, so it requires -으니까, not -니까.
-(으)면서 means doing two actions simultaneously, not indicating a cause.

5460348d380d395e.zh: 「주다」詞幹沒有收音，接「-ㄹ게요」組成「줄게요」，向對方承諾會還書。
5460348d380d395e.en: 주다 ends in a vowel, attaching -ㄹ게요 directly to yield 줄게요 as a promise.

5460348d380d395e.zh: 無收音動詞直接接「-ㄹ게요」，不能接「-을게요」，「주을게요」拼寫錯誤。
5460348d380d395e.en: Stems ending in a vowel take -ㄹ게요, so 주을게요 is ungrammatical.

5460348d380d395e.zh: 此語法正確拼寫為「-ㄹ게요」，寫成「줄께요」是常見的正字法錯誤。
5460348d380d395e.en: While pronounced like 줄께요, the standard Korean spelling is 줄게요.

5460348d380d395e.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ게요」用於承諾未來要採取的行動，不能接過去式「-었-」。
5460348d380d395e.en: -(으)ㄹ게요 is for future commitments and cannot be attached to past stem 줬-.

5675845b3bbf31e7.en: For stems ending in ㄹ like 살다, the ㄹ drops before 는, forming 사는.
5675845b3bbf31e7.zh: 詞幹以ㄹ結尾的動詞接는時，ㄹ脫落成為「사는」。

5675845b3bbf31e7.en: ㄹ irregular verbs drop the ㄹ before 는, so 살는 is ungrammatical.
5675845b3bbf31e7.zh: 韓語中ㄹ遇到ㄴ時必須脫落，不可直接寫成「살는」。

5675845b3bbf31e7.en: The stem 살 loses its ㄹ, but does not turn into an extra ㄴ, so 산는 is incorrect.
5675845b3bbf31e7.zh: ㄹ脫落後直接接는，不可以變成ㄴ尾音的「산는」。

5675845b3bbf31e7.en: Present modifier for verbs uses 는 rather than 은, making 살은 ungrammatical.
5675845b3bbf31e7.zh: 現在修飾名詞接는而不是은，「살은」也是錯誤形式。

575c8b78bcb5baf5.zh: 動詞詞幹 버리- 直接接 -지 마세요 表否定命令。
575c8b78bcb5baf5.en: The verb stem 버리- correctly attaches directly to -지 마세요.

575c8b78bcb5baf5.zh: 否定命令句型必須包含接尾辭 -지，不能省略。
575c8b78bcb5baf5.en: The negative imperative requires -지 before 마세요.

575c8b78bcb5baf5.zh: 此否定命令句型固定用 -지 마세요，非 안 버리 마세요。
575c8b78bcb5baf5.en: Negative requests use -지 마세요, not 안 버리 마세요.

575c8b78bcb5baf5.zh: 말다 遇到 -(으)세요 時 ㄹ 脫落，變為 마세요。
575c8b78bcb5baf5.en: 말다 drops its final ㄹ before -(으)세요, becoming 마세요.

59e96df642773ccd.zh: 名詞「남편」有收音，尊稱接「-이시군요」，表示剛得知的感嘆與敬意。
59e96df642773ccd.en: Noun 남편 has a final consonant, so honorific copula with surprise takes 이시군요.

59e96df642773ccd.zh: 「남편」最後有收音，若接名詞尊稱需要加「이」，不能直接接「시군요」。
59e96df642773ccd.en: Because 남편 ends in a batchim, it requires 이 before 시군요, not just 시군요.

59e96df642773ccd.zh: 韓語沒有「-이세군요」的語法形態，尊敬詞綴應使用「-(이)시-」。
59e96df642773ccd.en: 이세군요 is an incorrect grammatical form; the honorific suffix before -군요 is -(이)시-.

59e96df642773ccd.zh: 名詞尊稱感嘆型為「-(이)시군요」，「-시는군요」用於動詞現在式，此處型態冗餘錯誤。
59e96df642773ccd.en: For nouns, the honorific ending is -(이)시군요; -시는군요 is used after action verb stems.

5a9c4447083e63d3.en: -기 전에 always attaches to the plain present stem, even if the main sentence is past tense.
5a9c4447083e63d3.zh: 「-기 전에」固定接動詞原形詞幹，即使主句是過去式也不變。

5a9c4447083e63d3.en: Past tense markers like -았- are never attached to -기 전에; use the basic stem.
5a9c4447083e63d3.zh: 「-기 전에」不可加上過去式詞綴「-았/었-」，只能用原形詞幹。

5a9c4447083e63d3.en: 온 is a past noun-modifying form; the grammar pattern requires -기 전에.
5a9c4447083e63d3.zh: 「온」是過去冠形詞形式，不能與「전에」構成「在…之前」的句型。

5a9c4447083e63d3.en: 오는 is a present noun-modifying form; before doing an action is properly formed with -기 전에.
5a9c4447083e63d3.zh: 「오는」是現在冠形詞形式，要表達「…之前」必須使用「-기 전에」。

5baf0d05e320721c.en: Correct. -기로 하다 expresses an arrangement or decision with someone.
5baf0d05e320721c.zh: 「-기로 하다」用於約定或決定，符合句意。

5baf0d05e320721c.en: 만나려면 means if one intends to meet, which cannot be followed by 했어요 here.
5baf0d05e320721c.zh: 「만나려면」表示「如果要見面的話」，後面不接「했어요」。

5baf0d05e320721c.en: 만나다가 means while meeting, which does not collocate with 했어요 in this way.
5baf0d05e320721c.zh: 「만나다가」表示動作中斷轉換，與「했어요」無法搭配。

5baf0d05e320721c.en: 만나느라고 expresses because of meeting as an excuse, not a decision.
5baf0d05e320721c.zh: 「만나느라고」表示因見面而導致負面結果，不合句型。

5c0f887eaa31dce2.zh: 「-지 마세요」接在 마시- 後，表示請不要喝。
5c0f887eaa31dce2.en: -지 마세요 attaches to 마시- to form the polite prohibition please don't drink.

5c0f887eaa31dce2.zh: 「-지 않으세요」是陳述或疑問型，不是請對方不要做。
5c0f887eaa31dce2.en: -지 않으세요 is an honorific negative statement or question, not an imperative.

5c0f887eaa31dce2.zh: 「-면」表示如果，不能與 마세요 搭配表示否定命令。
5c0f887eaa31dce2.en: -면 means if and does not link with 마세요 to express a command.

5c0f887eaa31dce2.zh: 말다 與 -(으)세요 結合時 ㄹ 脫落，不是 말으세요。
5c0f887eaa31dce2.en: The stem 말다 loses its ㄹ before -(으)세요, becoming 마세요, not 말으세요.

5e3acd78e8cc4d45.en: Correct. Nouns ending in a vowel take 나 to mean 'or'.
5e3acd78e8cc4d45.zh: 正確。名詞無尾音接「(이)나」的「나」表示「或者」。

5e3acd78e8cc4d45.en: 거나 attaches to verb and adjective stems, not directly to nouns.
5e3acd78e8cc4d45.zh: 「거나」是連接動詞或形容詞，不能直接接名詞。

5e3acd78e8cc4d45.en: 이나 is only used after nouns ending in a final consonant.
하고나 is ungrammatical in this noun-listing context.

61d7914253009603.en: To describe a noun in the present or habitually, attach 는 to the verb stem, making 가는.
61d7914253009603.zh: 修飾名詞表示現在或習慣時，動詞詞幹接「가는」。

61d7914253009603.en: 간 is the past modifier form, meaning a café that I went to.
61d7914253009603.zh: 「간」是過去修飾形，意思會變成「去過的咖啡廳」。

61d7914253009603.en: 갈 is the future modifier form, meaning a café that I will go to.
61d7914253009603.zh: 「갈」是未來修飾形，意思會變成「將要去的咖啡廳」。

61d7914253009603.en: 가요 is a sentence-ending form and cannot directly modify a following noun.
61d7914253009603.zh: 「가요」是句尾終結詞尾，不能直接修飾後面的名詞。

6285d44b9d3e6934.zh: 時間副詞在首，受詞 책을 接 읽거나 表二選一，後接並列動作 산책해요。
6285d44b9d3e6934.en: The time expression 심심할 때는 leads, followed by the object and verb 책을 읽거나, completing the choice with 산책해요.

65b578d22117ab11.zh: 動詞「살다」語幹遇到「-는」時，「ㄹ」脫落，因此為「사는」。
65b578d22117ab11.en: When 살다 meets the modifier ending -는, final ㄹ drops out, giving 사는.

65b578d22117ab11.zh: 「살는」未套用「ㄹ」脫落規則，是不正確的形式。
65b578d22117ab11.en: 살는 is ungrammatical because the stem-final ㄹ must drop before -는.

65b578d22117ab11.zh: 「산는」是不合文法的形式，不能同時加「ㄴ」和「는」。
65b578d22117ab11.en: 산는 is incorrect; you cannot attach both ㄴ and 는 to the verb stem.

65b578d22117ab11.zh: 「살은」是不合文法的形式，「살다」的過去式定語應為「산」。
65b578d22117ab11.en: 살은 is grammatically incorrect; the past modifier form of 살다 is 산.

66065c4fcb8ddea2.en: Correct. Action verbs take -는데 to set background context in the present tense.
66065c4fcb8ddea2.zh: 正確。動詞現在式接「-는데」提供背景說明。

66065c4fcb8ddea2.en: 온데 is incorrect because verbs in the present tense use -는데, not -(으)ㄴ데.
66065c4fcb8ddea2.zh: 「온데」是形容詞或過去式的接法，動詞現在式不能直接加 ㄴ데。

66065c4fcb8ddea2.en: 오은데 is ungrammatical; verbs take -는데 directly.
오던데 expresses recalling something witnessed in the past, not setting a simple present background.
66065c4fcb8ddea2.zh: 「오던데」表示回想過去親見的情況，與在此處單純鋪陳現狀不符。

67b0dbd0105df7cd.en: Correct. 만들다 loses its ㄹ before ㄴ, resulting in 만든.
67b0dbd0105df7cd.zh: 「만들다」為ㄹ不規則動詞，遇到「-(으)ㄴ」時脫落ㄹ變成「만든」。

67b0dbd0105df7cd.en: ㄹ-irregular stems drop ㄹ before ㄴ, making 만들은 ungrammatical.
67b0dbd0105df7cd.zh: ㄹ不規則動詞接母音或「ㄴ」時需脫落ㄹ，不會保留成「만들은」。

67b0dbd0105df7cd.en: 만드는 is the present modifier; the experience pattern requires the past -(으)ㄴ.
67b0dbd0105df7cd.zh: 「-는」表示現在進行或習慣，過去經驗文法必須用「-(으)ㄴ」。

67b0dbd0105df7cd.en: 만들 is just the bare stem and cannot modify the noun 적 without an ending.

6aa00ce58dadf51b.en: The pattern -(으)ㄴ 지 requires the past noun-modifying form 온 to express elapsed time since an action.
6aa00ce58dadf51b.zh: 句型「-(으)ㄴ 지」表示過去動作完成至今的時間，需用過去形「온」。

6aa00ce58dadf51b.en: 오는 is the present noun-modifying form and cannot be used with 지 되다.
6aa00ce58dadf51b.zh: 「오는」為現在進行冠形詞，無法與表示「事隔多久」的「지」搭配。

6aa00ce58dadf51b.en: 올 is the future noun-modifying form and cannot describe time elapsed since a past event.
6aa00ce58dadf51b.zh: 「올」為未來推測冠形詞，無法用於表達已發生的時間點。

6aa00ce58dadf51b.en: 와 is a verb connecting stem and cannot directly modify the bound noun 지.
6aa00ce58dadf51b.zh: 「와」為動詞基本接續形，不能直接修飾依存名詞「지」。

6b27e7cf97269dfd.en: Verbs and adjectives must take -기 때문에 to state a cause or reason.
6b27e7cf97269dfd.zh: 動詞或形容詞詞幹後需接「-기 때문에」表示客觀的原因或理由。

6b27e7cf97269dfd.en: 막히는 때문에 is ungrammatical; verbs must take -기 때문에, not -는 때문에.
6b27e7cf97269dfd.zh: 「-는 때문에」為錯誤文法形態，動詞詞幹必須加「-기」名詞化。

6b27e7cf97269dfd.en: 막혀 때문에 is incorrect because 때문에 cannot attach directly to an -아/어 form.
6b27e7cf97269dfd.zh: 「-어 때문에」為錯誤結構，不能直接拿非格式詞尾接「때문에」。

6b27e7cf97269dfd.en: 막힐 때문에 is grammatically non-existent for expressing reasons in Korean.
6b27e7cf97269dfd.zh: 「-ㄹ 때문에」是錯誤造詞，韓文中沒有這種句型表達原因。

6d48c09a7746c758.zh: 「-고 나서」接在動詞詞幹하-後，表示做完某事後。
6d48c09a7746c758.en: -고 나서 attaches to the verb stem 하- to mean after finishing an action.
-아 나서 is ungrammatical; the pattern requires -고 나서.
-기 나서 does not exist in Korean grammar.

6d48c09a7746c758.zh: 「-고 나서」前不能加過去時制詞尾-았-。
6d48c09a7746c758.en: -고 나서 attaches to the plain stem, not the past tense 았-.

6d8509f79a9e81d4.zh: 動詞詞幹 보다 無收音，接 -면서 表同時進行。
6d8509f79a9e81d4.en: The verb stem 보다 ends in a vowel, so it takes -면서 to show simultaneous actions.

6d8509f79a9e81d4.zh: 動詞詞幹無收音時不可接 -으면서，形式錯誤。
6d8509f79a9e81d4.en: Stems without a final consonant take -면서, so 보으면서 is incorrect.

6d8509f79a9e81d4.zh: 此句型應接在詞幹 보다 後，非活用形 봐。
6d8509f79a9e81d4.en: Attach -면서 directly to the base stem 보다, not the conjugated form 봐.

6d8509f79a9e81d4.zh: 表示同時進行的 -(으)면서 前不可加上過去式標記。
6d8509f79a9e81d4.en: Do not attach past-tense markers before -(으)면서.

6dd09db42fda40f4.zh: 受詞「저녁을」接動詞短語「먹고 나서」，再接主要動詞「산책해요」。
6dd09db42fda40f4.en: The object 저녁을 precedes the temporal clause 먹고 나서, which modifies the main verb 산책해요.

6e43c32fea89976a.zh: 時間 내일 放句首，接受詞 영화를、目的 보러 與背景 가는데 引出提議。
6e43c32fea89976a.en: Time word 내일 precedes object 영화를, purpose 보러, and background verb 가는데 before the invitation 같이 갈래요?.

6eae487362e95a5f.zh: 살다為ㄹ不規則動詞，脫落ㄹ後接-ㄴ形成「산」。
6eae487362e95a5f.en: 살다 is a ㄹ-irregular verb; ㄹ drops before -ㄴ to form 산 후에.

6eae487362e95a5f.zh: 살다遇到以ㄴ開頭的詞尾時ㄹ脫落，不寫成「살은」。
6eae487362e95a5f.en: When 살다 meets ㄴ, ㄹ drops, making 살은 ungrammatical.

6eae487362e95a5f.zh: 「사는 후에」語法錯誤，表完成後應用-(으)ㄴ 후에。
6eae487362e95a5f.en: 사는 후에 is grammatically incorrect; the pattern requires -(으)ㄴ 후에.

6eae487362e95a5f.zh: -던 후에不是表示單次動作完成後接續的慣用語法。
6eae487362e95a5f.en: -던 후에 is incorrect for expressing after completing a prior event.

6f669b0d86ddc730.zh: 後句為請求句，덥다為ㅂ不規則，接-(으)니까變為「더우니까」。
6f669b0d86ddc730.en: The ending -(으)니까 allows requests; 덥다 is an irregular ㅂ verb, conjugating to 더우니까.
-아서 cannot be followed by requests or commands like 열어 주세요.

6f669b0d86ddc730.zh: 덥다為ㅂ不規則變化，不能直接加-으니까。
6f669b0d86ddc730.en: 덥다 undergoes ㅂ-irregular change, so 덥으니까 is incorrect.

6f669b0d86ddc730.zh: 有收尾音時應接-으니까，且未依ㅂ不規則變換。
6f669b0d86ddc730.en: Stems with final consonants take -으니까, and ㅂ must change to 우.

6f6c42fe3a3bc083.en: 크다 takes -게 directly on its stem to form an adverb modifying write.
6f6c42fe3a3bc083.zh: 形容詞「크다」幹直接接副詞形字尾「-게」，修飾動詞「써 주세요」。

6f6c42fe3a3bc083.en: 큰게 is short for 큰 것이 (the big thing), not an adverb.
6f6c42fe3a3bc083.zh: 「큰게」是冠形詞加依託名詞「것이」的縮略，並非副詞形。

6f6c42fe3a3bc083.en: 커게 is wrong because -게 does not trigger the vowel shift to 커-.
6f6c42fe3a3bc083.zh: 「-게」接在詞幹「크-」後，不需經過元音變化變為「커-」。

6f6c42fe3a3bc083.en: 크는 uses the dynamic present modifier -는, which does not fit here.
6f6c42fe3a3bc083.zh: 「크다」為形容詞，不能接動詞現在式冠形詞尾「-는」。

70ab8bac3b061f01.zh: 主語「날씨가」配副詞「점점」，接形容詞漸變持續態「따뜻해지고 있어요」
70ab8bac3b061f01.en: Subject 날씨가 and adverb 점점 lead naturally to the progressing change 따뜻해지고 있어요.

70b9948dbda2ae65.zh: 「가다」無收音，接「-ㄹ래요」詢問對方意願，為正確形式。
70b9948dbda2ae65.en: 가다 has no final consonant, so it takes -ㄹ래요 to ask the listener's preference.
가다 ends in a vowel, so -을래요 is incorrect.

70b9948dbda2ae65.zh: 提議做某事時表達未來意願，不使用過去式「-았/었-」。
70b9948dbda2ae65.en: Making an invitation uses the future intention form, not past tense -았/었-.

70b9948dbda2ae65.zh: 韓語中沒有「-래까요」這種句尾形式。
70b9948dbda2ae65.en: -래까요 is not a valid grammatical ending in Korean.

7109225fb1ed4ac0.en: Correct. Adjectives with a final consonant take -은데 to introduce a suggestion.
7109225fb1ed4ac0.zh: 正確。形容詞「좋다」有尾音接「-은데」以鋪陳提議。

7109225fb1ed4ac0.en: 좋는데 is incorrect because adjectives take -(으)ㄴ데, not -는데.
좋은는데 is ungrammatical due to the redundant 는.
좋던데요 is a sentence-ending form recalling past experience, not a connective clause.
7109225fb1ed4ac0.zh: 「좋던데요」是用於句尾的回想終結詞尾，無法在此連接句子。

7110eacdb2e32258.en: Correct. The stem 하- has no final consonant, so it takes -면서 directly.
7110eacdb2e32258.zh: 正確。「하다」詞幹無尾音，直接接「-면서」。

7110eacdb2e32258.en: 해면서 incorrectly attaches to the informal stem 해- instead of 하-.
하으면서 is incorrect because vowel-final stems do not take 으.
하는면서 is ungrammatical; do not combine -는 with -면서.

73b4cfdae019a421.zh: 地點「여기에」加受詞「차를」，後接許可句型「세워도 돼요」。
73b4cfdae019a421.en: Place 여기에 and object 차를 precede the permission predicate 세워도 돼요.

746e838ead47d24e.zh: 動詞「타다」詞幹無收音，接「-(으)ㄴ 적이 없다」表示未有過的經驗
746e838ead47d24e.en: 탄 correctly attaches -(으)ㄴ to verb stem 타다 to express past experience.

746e838ead47d24e.zh: 「-는 적이 없다」不是表示過去經驗的正確形態，經驗句型需用過去冠形詞「-(으)ㄴ」
746e838ead47d24e.en: 타는 is the present modifier; the experience pattern requires the past -(으)ㄴ.

746e838ead47d24e.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」表示將來或推測，不能接「적이 없다」表示經驗
746e838ead47d24e.en: 탈 is the prospective modifier and cannot be used with 적이 없다.

746e838ead47d24e.zh: 「타」只是動詞詞幹或非敬語終結形，不能直接修飾後面的名詞「적」
746e838ead47d24e.en: 타 is an unconjugated verb stem and cannot directly modify the noun 적.

757b11b3df94d19f.zh: 主語「저는」後接賓語「한국 영화를」，再接過去經驗表達「본 적이」
757b11b3df94d19f.en: Subject 저는 and object 한국 영화를 are followed by modifier and noun 본 적이 before 있어요.

79388e7facf1009d.zh: 「물어보다」為慣用動詞「詢問」，接敬語結尾「-세요」。
79388e7facf1009d.en: 물어보다 means to ask; combined with -세요 it becomes 물어보세요.
있으세요 means please be/have, which does not collocate with 물어.
물어하다 is ungrammatical; the expression is 물어보다.
되세요 is the honorific of 되다 and does not follow 물어.

7a64463924ace9c3.zh: 「안 V-기로 했어요」表示決定不做某事，形式完全正確。
7a64463924ace9c3.en: The negative form 안 V-기로 했어요 correctly expresses a decision not to do an action.

7a64463924ace9c3.zh: 「안 가기를 했어요」文法不正確，決定不做某事應使用「-기로 하다」。
7a64463924ace9c3.en: 안 가기를 했어요 is ungrammatical; the pattern for deciding to do something requires -기로 하다.

7a64463924ace9c3.zh: 「-기로 있다」不是表示決定的文法結構。
7a64463924ace9c3.en: -기로 있다 is not a valid grammatical structure for expressing decisions.

7a64463924ace9c3.zh: 「해졌어요」是「해지다」（變得…），不能用來表示做下決定。
7a64463924ace9c3.en: 해졌어요 comes from -아/어지다 (to become) and cannot express making a decision.

7c01836826514bb6.zh: 主語「일이」接修飾句「끝난 후에」，最後接提議動詞「만나요」。
7c01836826514bb6.en: Subject 일이 connects to 끝난 후에, completed by the main predicate 만나요.

7db50573d155c0b7.zh: 針對過去時間「어제」，使用過去式詞幹「바빴-」接「-죠」。
7db50573d155c0b7.en: With yesterday's past context 어제, the past stem 바빴- attaches to -죠.

7db50573d155c0b7.zh: 「바쁘다」的過去式應發生母音縮合變成「바빴-」，而非「바쁘었-」。
7db50573d155c0b7.en: 바쁘다 contracts to 바빴- in the past tense, making 바쁘었죠 incorrect.

7db50573d155c0b7.zh: 動詞與形容詞的過去式詞幹直接接「-죠」，不需要加「이」。
7db50573d155c0b7.en: Past stems of predicates attach directly to -죠 without adding 이.

7db50573d155c0b7.zh: 冠形詞形「바쁜」不能直接接「-죠」構成句尾。
7db50573d155c0b7.en: The modifying form 바쁜 cannot attach directly to -죠.

7dc15aae5c371984.zh: 形容詞詞幹 많- 後面要接 -기 때문에 表示原因。
7dc15aae5c371984.en: The adjective stem 많- correctly attaches to -기 때문에 to express cause.

7dc15aae5c371984.zh: 冠詞形 많은 不能直接接 때문에，必須用 -기 때문에。
7dc15aae5c371984.en: The modifier form 많은 cannot directly attach to 때문에; use -기 때문에 instead.

7dc15aae5c371984.zh: 不能將 -아서 與 때문에 連在一起重複使用。
7dc15aae5c371984.en: Connecting -아서 directly to 때문에 is ungrammatical.

7dc15aae5c371984.zh: 덕분에 用於積極正面結果，且這裡不能去旅行並非好事。
7dc15aae5c371984.en: 덕분에 is only used for positive outcomes, which does not fit not being able to travel.

7ddaecae027198cf.zh: 「하다」詞幹接「-고 나서」，表示做完作業之後再看。
7ddaecae027198cf.en: The stem of 하다 attaches to -고 나서 to mean after finishing.

7ddaecae027198cf.zh: 「해」為非格式體口語形，不能直接接「나서」。
7ddaecae027198cf.en: 해 is an informal stem form and cannot attach directly to 나서.

7ddaecae027198cf.zh: 不存在「-고 나면서」這種搭配，表示做完後應為「-고 나서」。
7ddaecae027198cf.en: The form -고 나면서 does not exist; after finishing is -고 나서.

7ddaecae027198cf.zh: 「-고 나서」前方不可接過去式標記「-았/었-」。
7ddaecae027198cf.en: The past-tense marker -았/었- cannot precede -고 나서.

7f07204c8d1221ba.en: With 지금, the present modifier 는 attaches to the stem, forming 보는.
7f07204c8d1221ba.zh: 搭配「지금」表示正在進行，動詞詞幹接「보는」。

7f07204c8d1221ba.en: 본 is the past modifier form, which would mean the film I watched.
7f07204c8d1221ba.zh: 「본」是過去修飾形，意思會變成「看過的電影」。

7f07204c8d1221ba.en: 볼 is the future modifier form, meaning the film I will watch.
7f07204c8d1221ba.zh: 「볼」是未來修飾形，意思會變成「將要看的電影」。

7f07204c8d1221ba.en: 봐 is an informal polite sentence ending and cannot modify a noun directly.
7f07204c8d1221ba.zh: 「봐」是非正式句尾形態，不能直接放在名詞前修飾。

83a7b340ddef2f78.en: 왔군요 correctly uses the past tense with -군요 to express realization about yesterday's event.
83a7b340ddef2f78.zh: 「-군요」表示恍然大悟，談論昨天的過去事實須用過去式「왔군요」。

83a7b340ddef2f78.en: 오는군요 is in the present tense, so it conflicts with the past time marker 어제.
83a7b340ddef2f78.zh: 「오는군요」是現在式，無法與表示昨天的「어제」搭配。

83a7b340ddef2f78.en: 올군요 is an ungrammatical combination; -군요 does not attach directly to -(으)ㄹ.
83a7b340ddef2f78.zh: 「-군요」不與表示未來的「-(으)ㄹ」直接結合成「올군요」。

83a7b340ddef2f78.en: 와군요 is incorrect; the past stem of 오다 is 왔-, not 와-.
83a7b340ddef2f78.zh: 詞幹「오-」的過去式應為「왔-」，「와군요」形態錯誤。

8681e171edfb773c.zh: 「하다」與「-아야/어야 하다」結合時固定變為「해야 하다」。
8681e171edfb773c.en: 해야 correctly forms the obligation pattern with 하다, which irregularly contracts to 해.

8681e171edfb773c.zh: 「하야」是錯誤的拼寫，「하다」接「-아/어」時必須變為「해」。
8681e171edfb773c.en: 하야 is an incorrect conjugation; 하다 always combines with -아/어 to become 해.

8681e171edfb773c.zh: 「했어야」是過去回想或後悔語氣（本應該），與「오늘 밤」（今晚）不符。
8681e171edfb773c.en: 했어야 expresses past obligation or regret (should have), which contradicts 오늘 밤.

8681e171edfb773c.zh: 「하고야」是表示「一定要做到」的特殊句型，在此不符合文法與文意。
8681e171edfb773c.en: 하고야 expresses determination (e.g. 하고야 말다), not standard obligation with 해요.

87d273aa0813e97c.zh: 主語「제 동생은」接賓語「피아노를」，再接表示能力句型「칠 줄」與「알아요」相連。
87d273aa0813e97c.en: Subject 제 동생은 and object 피아노를 are followed by 칠 줄 and 알아요, forming the skill pattern V-(으)ㄹ 줄 알다.

895228c20318f73a.en: Correct. 재미있다 takes -어지다 to mean it is becoming fun.
895228c20318f73a.zh: 「재미있다」以「있」結尾，接陰性母音「-어지다」為正確形式。
表示狀態變化的文法是「-아/어지다」，不能寫成「-게지다」。

895228c20318f73a.en: 재미있지어요 is an incorrect conjugation pattern.
In modern Korean, -어지- with -어요 contracts to -어져요, not -어지어요.
895228c20318f73a.zh: 口語中「-어지어요」通常縮合為「-어져요」，此選項未正確縮約。

8a4b8222b00700a2.en: Nouns take 때문에 directly without -기, so 감기 때문에 is correct.
8a4b8222b00700a2.zh: 名詞「감기」後面應直接加「때문에」表示「因為感冒」。

8a4b8222b00700a2.en: 기 때문에 attaches to verb or adjective stems, not directly to nouns.
8a4b8222b00700a2.zh: 「기 때문에」只能接在動詞或形容詞詞幹後，不能直接接名詞。

8a4b8222b00700a2.en: 이기 때문에서 is awkward and ungrammatical; -서 should not be attached here.
8a4b8222b00700a2.zh: 「이기 때문에서」語尾助詞「-서」贅生且不自然，非標準用法。

8a4b8222b00700a2.en: 덕분에 means thanks to and is only used for positive outcomes, not illnesses.
8a4b8222b00700a2.zh: 「덕분에」表示「多虧……」，用於正面好結果，感冒生病不適用。

8c6396bf54d7cbef.en: 없다 ends in a final consonant, taking 으니까 to propose 택시를 탈까요.
8c6396bf54d7cbef.zh: 「없다」有收音接「으니까」，後句為共動/提議句「-ㄹ까요」。

8c6396bf54d7cbef.en: 없다 has a consonant coda (받침), so it requires 으니까 rather than 니까.
-어서 expresses cause but cannot be paired with a suggestion like -ㄹ까요.
8c6396bf54d7cbef.zh: 「-어서」表原因時，後句不可接提議句型「-ㄹ까요」。

8c6396bf54d7cbef.en: -(으)면서 means while doing something simultaneously, which makes no sense here.
8c6396bf54d7cbef.zh: 「-(으)면서」表示「一邊…一邊」，兩件事同時進行，不合邏輯。

8d6da7d4353885cb.en: The stem 깨끗하- attaches -게 directly to make an adverb (cleanly).
8d6da7d4353885cb.zh: 形容詞「깨끗하다」去「다」直接接「-게」形成副詞修飾掃除。

8d6da7d4353885cb.en: 깨끗해게 is an incorrect conjugation; -게 attaches to the stem 깨끗하-.
8d6da7d4353885cb.zh: 「-게」直接接在詞幹「깨끗하-」之後，不能寫成「깨끗해게」。

8d6da7d4353885cb.en: 깨끗한 is a noun-modifying form, unable to modify the verb 청소했어요.
8d6da7d4353885cb.zh: 「깨끗한」是修飾名詞的冠形詞形，後面不能直接修飾動詞。

8d6da7d4353885cb.en: 깨끗하고서 combines an adjective with -고서 (and then), which is unnatural.

8e1b0c2934c406a7.zh: 動詞詞幹接「-게 되다」表示因情況變化而變得能做好某事
8e1b0c2934c406a7.en: 먹게 correctly combines with 되다 in the pattern -게 되다 to express a change in situation.

8e1b0c2934c406a7.zh: 「먹어」接「되다」不構成表示狀態變化的文法「-게 되다」
8e1b0c2934c406a7.en: 먹어 cannot combine with 되다 to mean come to eat; the pattern requires -게.

8e1b0c2934c406a7.zh: 「-도록」表示目的或使動程度，不與「되다」搭配表示自然而然的轉變
8e1b0c2934c406a7.en: 먹도록 expresses purpose or extent, not the standard pattern -게 되다.

8e1b0c2934c406a7.zh: 「먹기」是名詞化形態，不能直接接「됐어요」來表示變得能吃
8e1b0c2934c406a7.en: 먹기 is a nominalized form and does not form the pattern with 됐어요.

8e3a4aa7a24f89ae.zh: 主語길이加副詞많이接原因막혀서，最後接結果늦었어요。
8e3a4aa7a24f89ae.en: Subject 길이 and adverb 많이 precede the cause 막혀서, followed by the result 늦었어요.

8e7b59da4b8817cf.en: 늦다 has the vowel ㅡ, so it takes -어서 to give a reason.
늦다 does not have a bright vowel, so -아서 is incorrect.
The past tense suffix -었- cannot precede -어서.
8e7b59da4b8817cf.zh: 原因詞尾「-어서」前面不能包含過去式「-었-」。

8e7b59da4b8817cf.en: 늦지만 means although I am late, which does not fit an apology.
8e7b59da4b8817cf.zh: 「늦지만」表示「雖然遲到……」，不能用來道歉。

8f56571e47290c72.zh: 動詞詞幹 빼- 無收音，接 -려고 表「為了…」的目的或意圖。
8f56571e47290c72.en: The stem 빼- ends in a vowel, so it takes -려고 to express the intention or purpose.

8f56571e47290c72.zh: -(으)러 表目的時，後句僅能搭配 가다/오다 等移動動詞。
8f56571e47290c72.en: -(으)러 must be followed by motion verbs like 가다 or 오다, not 운동하다.

8f56571e47290c72.zh: -(으)려면 表「如果想要…」，後句應接建議或必要條件。
8f56571e47290c72.en: -(으)려면 means if one intends to, typically requiring a condition or advice afterwards.

8f56571e47290c72.zh: -(으)려고 前面不可接過去式標記 었/았。

902544b5bfe3a723.zh: 「-(으)면 안 되다」表示禁止，찍다 接 -으면 안 돼요。
902544b5bfe3a723.en: -(으)면 안 되다 expresses prohibition, taking -으면 안 돼요 after 찍다.

902544b5bfe3a723.zh: 禁止句型固定搭配 되다，不能換成 안 해요。
902544b5bfe3a723.en: The prohibition pattern uses 되다, not 안 해요.

902544b5bfe3a723.zh: 禁止句型的固定否定形式是 안 되다，不是 못 돼요。
902544b5bfe3a723.en: The set prohibition pattern uses 안 되다, not 못 돼요.

902544b5bfe3a723.zh: 禁止句型應為 -(으)면 안 되다，而非 -지 안 돼요。
902544b5bfe3a723.en: The prohibition structure is -(으)면 안 되다, not -지 안 돼요.

909ee5986c56bf4e.en: 일어나다 has the vowel ㅏ, merging naturally with -아야 into 일어나야.
Because the stem vowel is ㅏ, it requires -아야 rather than -어야, and it contracts.
909ee5986c56bf4e.zh: 詞幹最後母音是「ㅏ」，應接「-아야」而非「-어야」，且需縮合。

909ee5986c56bf4e.en: When identical ㅏ vowels meet, they merge into 나 instead of staying as 나아.
909ee5986c56bf4e.zh: 「ㅏ」相遇時應縮合成單一音節「나」，寫成「나아야」不符合拼寫。

909ee5986c56bf4e.en: The pattern attaches directly to the present stem, not the past tense form 일어났.
909ee5986c56bf4e.zh: 「-아야/어야」應接在基本詞幹後，不能使用過去式「일어났」。

90b473425940c026.zh: 動詞詞幹 만나- 無收音，接 -(으)려고 하다 表「打算做某事」。
90b473425940c026.en: The stem 만나- ends in a vowel and combines with -려고 하다 to express an intention.

90b473425940c026.zh: -(으)러 只能搭配移動動詞，不能與 하다 連用。
90b473425940c026.en: -(으)러 cannot combine with 하다; it requires motion verbs like 가다 or 오다.

90b473425940c026.zh: -(으)려면 是 -(으)려고 하면 的縮寫，不與 했어요 連用。
90b473425940c026.en: -(으)려면 means if intending to and cannot simply connect to 했다.

90b473425940c026.zh: 意圖句型 -(으)려고 前面不能加過去式標記 았/었。
90b473425940c026.en: Do not attach the past-tense suffix to the verb before -(으)려고.

90bc12b6ad1c20e2.zh: 主詞「시간이」與動詞「있을」加「때」構成時間子句，後接祈使句「전화하세요」。
90bc12b6ad1c20e2.en: 시간이 connects to 있을 때 to form the conditional clause, completed by the imperative 전화하세요.

91c7b8c9a1a4c51d.en: 오니까 is correct because imperative and propositive suggestions require -(으)니까, not -기 때문에.
91c7b8c9a1a4c51d.zh: 後句是命令或勸誘句時，原因理由必須使用「-(으)니까」。

91c7b8c9a1a4c51d.en: 오기 때문에 cannot be followed by imperative endings like -세요 in the main clause.
91c7b8c9a1a4c51d.zh: 「-기 때문에」後句不能使用「-세요」等命令句或提議句。

91c7b8c9a1a4c51d.en: 오는 바람에 expresses an unexpected negative outcome and cannot precede an imperative.
91c7b8c9a1a4c51d.zh: 「-는 바람에」用於無意發生的消極不良後果，且不能接命令句。

91c7b8c9a1a4c51d.en: 오느라고 provides a personal excuse for a negative result and cannot take imperatives.
91c7b8c9a1a4c51d.zh: 「-느라고」用於前後主詞一致的忙碌藉口，且不能用於命令句。

931071e86b97a9a8.zh: 回應用「제가（我來）」，主動向對方承諾由自己做，故選「할게요」。
931071e86b97a9a8.en: In response to who will wash dishes, 제가 할게요 promises 'I will do it'.

931071e86b97a9a8.zh: 「할까요」用於提議或詢問對方意見（要不要我做？），不是明確表達自己會做的回答。
931071e86b97a9a8.en: 할까요 is a question asking listener's intention or suggestion, not a declarative promise.

931071e86b97a9a8.zh: 「하세요」是用於要求或勸誘對方的敬語指令，不能用於第一人稱「제가」的主詞。
931071e86b97a9a8.en: 하세요 is an imperative/request directed at the listener; it cannot follow subject 제가.

931071e86b97a9a8.zh: 「했어요」是過去式（洗過了），但對方問的是接下來誰要做，時態不符。
931071e86b97a9a8.en: 했어요 means 'I did it' in the past, but the question asks who will do it.

961be6837cc80f42.zh: 걷다 為 ㄷ 不規則動詞，遇到母音變為 ㄹ 接 -으면서。
961be6837cc80f42.en: 걷다 is an irregular ㄷ verb; ㄷ changes to ㄹ before vowels, giving 걸으면서.

961be6837cc80f42.zh: 걷다 遇到母音會產生 ㄷ 規則變化，不維持 ㄷ。
961be6837cc80f42.en: 걷다 is an irregular verb, so 걷으면서 fails to change ㄷ to ㄹ.

961be6837cc80f42.zh: 不規則變化為 걸- 後仍視為有收音，須接 -으면서。
961be6837cc80f42.en: After changing to 걸-, the stem still has a final consonant, requiring -으면서.

961be6837cc80f42.zh: 此句型直接接詞幹並依規則變化，不加 -어- 連接。

96779bccf6e0d7e7.zh: 形容詞詞幹「재미있-」直接接「-지요」，確認對方的想法。
96779bccf6e0d7e7.en: The stem 재미있- directly attaches to -지요 to ask for confirmation.
-지요 attaches directly to the verb stem without inserting -어-.

96779bccf6e0d7e7.zh: 「-지요」不論有無收音都直接連接，不加「-으-」。
96779bccf6e0d7e7.en: -지요 connects directly to stems regardless of final consonants; no -으- is added.

96779bccf6e0d7e7.zh: 不存在「-기요」這種尋求認同的句尾形式。
96779bccf6e0d7e7.en: -기요 is not a valid grammatical ending for confirmation.

969f9d96bf9be86d.zh: 時間副詞「이번 주말에」與「같이」置前，修飾「영화 볼래요」。
969f9d96bf9be86d.en: Time 이번 주말에 and adverb 같이 come first, leading into the object 영화 and the question 볼래요.

9bd481e58b71b2b7.en: Correct. 읽다 ends in a consonant, so it takes -을 줄 알다 to express ability.
9bd481e58b71b2b7.zh: 「읽다」詞幹有收音，接「-을 줄 알다」表示會讀。

9bd481e58b71b2b7.en: 읽는 is the present attributive form, not used in the -(으)ㄹ 줄 알다 pattern.
9bd481e58b71b2b7.zh: 「읽는」是現在修飾形，不能接在能力句型「줄 알다」前。

9bd481e58b71b2b7.en: 읽ㄹ is an invalid form; stems with final consonants require 을.
9bd481e58b71b2b7.zh: 「읽ㄹ」形態拼寫錯誤，有收音的動詞應加「-을」。

9bd481e58b71b2b7.en: 읽은 is the past modifier and does not express ability with 줄 알다.
9bd481e58b71b2b7.zh: 「읽은」是過去修飾形，不能表示懂得該技能的用法。

9c059c589e62cd85.zh: 地點語 여기에서 接賓語 담배를，再接動詞 피우면 與否定 안 돼요 表禁止。
9c059c589e62cd85.en: Place 여기에서 precedes 담배를, which attaches to 피우면 followed by 안 돼요 to complete the prohibition pattern.

9db45245eca09886.zh: 先述原因 위험하니까，接地點 여기에서 與否定命令 수영하지 마세요。
9db45245eca09886.en: The reason 위험하니까 precedes location 여기에서, followed by the negative command 수영하지 and 마세요.

a1518af5bd77cf21.zh: 먹다有收音，接「-으면」構成條件句「如果吃了」。
a1518af5bd77cf21.en: 먹다 has a final consonant, so it takes -으면 to express the condition if.

a1518af5bd77cf21.zh: 有收音的語幹後面應接「-으면」，不可直接接「-면」。
a1518af5bd77cf21.en: Stems with a final consonant require -으면 instead of -면.

a1518af5bd77cf21.zh: 「-지만」表示轉折「雖然……但是」，與後文語境不符。
a1518af5bd77cf21.en: -지만 means but or although, which does not fit this conditional context.

a1518af5bd77cf21.zh: 「-었으면서」表過去同時轉折「明明……卻」，形態與意思皆不合。
a1518af5bd77cf21.en: -었으면서 means even though in the past, which does not make sense here.

a17fc50eef87f173.zh: 回答自己想要什麼時，用「먹을래요」表達個人意願。
a17fc50eef87f173.en: 먹을래요 is used here to state one's own intention or choice.

a17fc50eef87f173.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ까요」用於詢問他人意見或提議，不能用於陳述句表達自己意願。
a17fc50eef87f173.en: -(으)ㄹ까요 is used for questions and suggestions, not for stating one's own choice in a statement.

a17fc50eef87f173.zh: 「-(으)세요」用於請對方做某事，不能用來陳述自己的行為。
a17fc50eef87f173.en: -(으)세요 is an imperative form used to tell someone else what to do.

a17fc50eef87f173.zh: 「-(으)ㅂ시다」意為「我們一起做……吧」，不適用於回答個人選擇。
a17fc50eef87f173.en: -(으)ㅂ시다 means 'let's', which does not fit answering for oneself.

a262d216d273ca62.en: The pattern -아/어도 돼요? is the standard way to ask permission.
a262d216d273ca62.zh: 「-아/어도 돼요?」是固定句型，用來詢問「可以…嗎？」。

a262d216d273ca62.en: The phrase 찍어도 해요 is not a natural or correct expression for permission.
a262d216d273ca62.zh: 「찍어도 해요」不是韓語中用來請求許可的正確句型。

a262d216d273ca62.en: The ending -아/어도 cannot pair with 있어요 to ask for permission.
a262d216d273ca62.zh: 「-아/어도 있어요」不存在此種表示許可的搭配。

a262d216d273ca62.en: The verb 줘요 means give/do for me, not used with -도 to mean may I.
a262d216d273ca62.zh: 「줘요」搭配「-아/어」表示為某人做某事，不能接「-도」表示許可。

a296fa85c0c30cb2.en: The nominalising suffix -기 turns the verb stem 자- into a noun clause before 전에.
a296fa85c0c30cb2.zh: 動詞「자다」加上名詞形字尾「-기」構成「자기 전에」（睡前）。

a296fa85c0c30cb2.en: -는 전에 is incorrect; the Korean structure for before doing is strictly -기 전에.
a296fa85c0c30cb2.zh: 「-는 전에」不是標準句型，動詞修飾「전」時固定用「-기 전에」。

a296fa85c0c30cb2.en: -고 means and; it cannot precede 전에 to express before doing an action.
a296fa85c0c30cb2.zh: 「-고」表示動作並列或相繼發生，不能直接與「전에」連用。

a296fa85c0c30cb2.en: -서 is a clausal connective particle and cannot directly attach before 전에.

a29d65723d1098c9.zh: 回答過去未曾有過的經驗，須用過去式「못 가 봤어요」。
a29d65723d1098c9.en: To answer about past experience, use the past form 못 가 봤어요.

a29d65723d1098c9.zh: 「가 봐요」是現在式，無法回答是否有過該經驗。
a29d65723d1098c9.en: 가 봐요 is present tense and does not express past experience.

a29d65723d1098c9.zh: 「가 볼 거예요」表示未來打算去，不符合回答「去過了嗎」。
a29d65723d1098c9.en: 가 볼 거예요 expresses future intention, not whether you have been.

a29d65723d1098c9.zh: 「가 보세요」是請對方去看看的命令形，不能用於回答自己。
a29d65723d1098c9.en: 가 보세요 is an imperative suggestion, which cannot refer to oneself.

a3a5631fc5791692.zh: 動詞「배우다」無收音，接「-ㄴ 적이 있다」表示「有學過的經驗」
a3a5631fc5791692.en: 배운 attaches past noun-modifying -ㄴ to 배우다, fitting the pattern -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다.

a3a5631fc5791692.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」表示未來打算，不能與「적이 있다」搭配表達過去的經驗
a3a5631fc5791692.en: 배울 is the prospective modifier and does not fit the past experience pattern.

a3a5631fc5791692.zh: 「-는」表示現在進行或習慣，表達「曾經做過某事」須用過去形「-(으)ㄴ」
a3a5631fc5791692.en: 배우는 is the present tense modifier, whereas experience requires past -(으)ㄴ.

a3a5631fc5791692.zh: 過去詞尾「-었-」不能直接加「-은」來修飾「적」，屬於錯誤造詞
a3a5631fc5791692.en: 배웠은 is an ungrammatical combination; past modifier takes -ㄴ, not -었은.

a5abf9d43fa3c18f.zh: 길다為ㄹ不規則形容詞，遇ㄴ時收音ㄹ脫落，變為「긴」。
a5abf9d43fa3c18f.en: 길다 drops its final ㄹ when adding -(으)ㄴ, correctly forming 긴 to modify a noun.

a5abf9d43fa3c18f.zh: 語幹以ㄹ結尾的形容詞修飾名詞時不接「-은」，ㄹ會脫落接ㄴ。
a5abf9d43fa3c18f.en: Adjective stems in ㄹ do not take -은; ㄹ drops before ㄴ.

a5abf9d43fa3c18f.zh: 形容詞修飾名詞不能加動詞專用的「-는」。
a5abf9d43fa3c18f.en: Adjectives take -(으)ㄴ, not the verbal modifier -는.

a5abf9d43fa3c18f.zh: 形容詞不接「-는」，且遇ㄴ時收音ㄹ會脫落。
a5abf9d43fa3c18f.en: Adjectives do not use -는, and ㄹ must drop before ㄴ.

a6d91352a873f3e1.zh: 受詞 음악을 接 들으면서 表同時邊聽音樂，後接做作業的主句。
a6d91352a873f3e1.en: 음악을 들으면서 expresses doing an action while listening to music, followed by the main clause 숙제를 했어요.

a7c31984800cd264.zh: 쓰다遇-어서時母音ㅡ脫落變為「써서」，表動作前後相連。
a7c31984800cd264.en: The stem vowel ㅡ drops before -어서 to form 써서, connecting sequential actions.

a7c31984800cd264.zh: 쓰다與-어서結合時ㅡ必須脫落，不可保留寫成「쓰어서」。
a7c31984800cd264.en: The vowel ㅡ in 쓰다 must drop when adding -어서, so 쓰어서 is incorrect.
-아서/어서 cannot be combined with the past tense suffix 았/었.

a7c31984800cd264.zh: 條件尾應為「쓰면」，且這裡語意為寫了之後寄出。
a7c31984800cd264.en: The conditional form is 쓰면, and here the meaning is sequential action, not if.

a9f55c5ddb67b01b.zh: 形容詞詞幹「즐겁-」加「-게」形成副詞「즐겁게」，修飾動詞「놀고 있어요」。
a9f55c5ddb67b01b.en: -게 attaches directly to the adjective stem 즐겁- to form the adverb 즐겁게 (happily).

a9f55c5ddb67b01b.zh: 「즐거운」是冠形詞形，用來修飾名詞，不能修飾動詞「놀고 있어요」。
a9f55c5ddb67b01b.en: 즐거운 is a noun-modifying adjective form, not an adverb that can modify 놀고 있어요.

a9f55c5ddb67b01b.zh: 副詞字尾「-게」直接接在詞幹後，不發生ㅂ不規則變化，故非「즐거워게」。
a9f55c5ddb67b01b.en: The ending -게 attaches directly to the stem without triggering the ㅂ-irregular change to 워.

aaaf54ad22ebebca.zh: 名詞「김 선생님」有收音，加上敬語後為「-이시죠」。
aaaf54ad22ebebca.en: The consonant-ending noun takes the honorific copula form -이시죠.

aaaf54ad22ebebca.zh: 「선생님」有收音，必須加上媒介音「이」構成「이시죠」。
aaaf54ad22ebebca.en: 선생님 ends in a consonant, requiring the connecting vowel 이 before -시죠.

aaaf54ad22ebebca.zh: 「이죠요」是重複接續敬語詞尾的錯誤形式。
aaaf54ad22ebebca.en: 이죠요 redundantly stacks polite endings and is ungrammatical.

aaaf54ad22ebebca.zh: 不存在「-이세죠」的形式，敬語確認句尾為「-이시죠」。
aaaf54ad22ebebca.en: -이세죠 is an incorrect form; the correct honorific confirmation is -이시죠.

aac1eeccef742873.en: 만나다 has a bright vowel, combining with -아서 into 만나서.
고서 would attach directly to 만나-, but the sentence already has 만나.
aac1eeccef742873.zh: 「고서」接在詞幹「만나-」後面，此處前面已有「만나」。

aac1eeccef742873.en: Past tense -았- cannot be used before the sequential connector -아서.
aac1eeccef742873.zh: 連接詞尾「-아서」前不可重複加入過去時制「-았-」。

aac1eeccef742873.en: 지만 expresses contrast (but/although), which does not fit here.
aac1eeccef742873.zh: 「지만」表示轉折「雖然……但是」，不符上下文。

ab3ee1a8021dc573.en: 마시다 ends in a vowel, so it takes -ㄹ래요 to become 마실래요.
마시다 has no final consonant, so it cannot take -을래요.

ab3ee1a8021dc573.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ래요」表達當下意願，不與過去式「-았/었-」連用。
ab3ee1a8021dc573.en: -(으)ㄹ래요 expresses current intention and does not combine with past tense -았/었-.

ab3ee1a8021dc573.zh: 「-래까요」是將不同句尾混雜的錯誤形式。
ab3ee1a8021dc573.en: -래까요 is an incorrect ending combining different grammar forms.

ac1d3fa0b186d4b6.en: The stem 심심하- ends in a vowel, so it takes ㄹ 때, giving 할.
ac1d3fa0b186d4b6.zh: 形容詞詞幹無收音時接ㄹ 때，故選「할」。

ac1d3fa0b186d4b6.en: 하는 is the present modifier for nouns, not used in the pattern (으)ㄹ 때.
ac1d3fa0b186d4b6.zh: 「하는」是修飾名詞的現在冠形詞尾，不與때搭配。

ac1d3fa0b186d4b6.en: 한 is the modifier form used directly before nouns, not used before 때.
ac1d3fa0b186d4b6.zh: 「한」是形容詞修飾名詞的過去或狀態形，不能接때。

ac1d3fa0b186d4b6.en: 해 is a sentence ending or connecting form, not the modifier required before 때.
ac1d3fa0b186d4b6.zh: 「해」是口語終結形或連接形，不能直接接때。

ac67808ae26905c4.zh: 方向語「서울로」修飾「이사한」，與「지 한 달이」相連，構成「-(으)ㄴ 지 時間 되다」句型。
ac67808ae26905c4.en: 서울로 attaches to 이사한, which links to 지 and the time duration 한 달이, completing the V-(으)ㄴ 지 [time] 되다 pattern.

ae5d7e25650e4437.zh: 形容詞 시끄럽다 屬 ㅂ 不規則，變為 시끄러우- 後接 -ㄴ데。
ae5d7e25650e4437.en: The adjective 시끄럽다 is ㅂ-irregular, changing to 시끄러우- before taking -ㄴ데.

ae5d7e25650e4437.zh: 形容詞不接 -는데，且 ㅂ 遇到元音時需變化。
ae5d7e25650e4437.en: Adjectives take -(으)ㄴ데 rather than -는데, and irregular ㅂ must change.

ae5d7e25650e4437.zh: ㅂ 不規則變化應轉化為 우，不能直接刪除 ㅂ 成 시끄러-。
ae5d7e25650e4437.en: The irregular ㅂ changes to 우, it is not simply deleted into 시끄러-.

ae5d7e25650e4437.zh: ㅂ 遇到元音語尾應變為 우，不能直接保留 ㅂ 並加 은데。
ae5d7e25650e4437.en: ㅂ becomes 우 before a vowel suffix; it cannot remain as ㅂ followed by 은데.

aeac77510416ee11.zh: 動詞冠形詞形 -는 後接 동안 表「…期間、在…的過程中」。
aeac77510416ee11.en: 동안 follows the modifying form -는 to mean during or while.

aeac77510416ee11.zh: 加上主格助詞 이 會變成主詞，無法順暢連接後續祈使句。
aeac77510416ee11.en: Adding the subject marker 이 is ungrammatical before the following imperative clause.

aeac77510416ee11.zh: 動詞冠形形 -는 後直接接名詞 동안，不需要加屬格助詞 의。
aeac77510416ee11.en: Modifying clause forms connect directly to 동안 without the possessive 의.

aeac77510416ee11.zh: -는 때문에 是錯誤結構，且文義為原因而非「在…期間」。
aeac77510416ee11.en: 때문에 indicates cause rather than duration, and -는 때문에 is ungrammatical.

b02389d38a43db3b.zh: 오다語幹無收音，接「-면」構成「如果來」的條件。
b02389d38a43db3b.en: 오다 ends in an open syllable without a batchim, so it takes -면.

b02389d38a43db3b.zh: 語幹無收音時直接加「-면」，不需加「으」。
b02389d38a43db3b.en: Stems without a batchim take -면 directly without 으.

b02389d38a43db3b.zh: 條件句假設未來狀況，且形態不可直接在過去式後接「-면」。
b02389d38a43db3b.en: Hypothetical conditions on stems use present stems; 왔면 is grammatically incorrect.

b02389d38a43db3b.zh: 오다原型語幹為오-，接-면應成「오면」而非「와면」。
b02389d38a43db3b.en: The basic stem is 오-, so adding -면 results in 오면, not 와면.

b14c6b9577d3ab92.en: The stem 앉- has the bright vowel ㅏ, so it takes -아도 돼요 to ask permission.
b14c6b9577d3ab92.zh: 動詞「앉다」母音為ㅏ，接「-아도 돼요」表示請求或給予許可。

b14c6b9577d3ab92.en: The form 앉도 omits the connecting vowel -아- and is grammatically incorrect.
b14c6b9577d3ab92.zh: 「앉도」漏掉了母音連接詞尾「-아-」，形態不正確。

b14c6b9577d3ab92.en: The ending 앉으면 means if you sit, not may I sit.
b14c6b9577d3ab92.zh: 「앉으면」表示條件「如果坐」，不符合「可以…嗎」的許可句型。

b14c6b9577d3ab92.en: The form 앉고도 means even after sitting, which does not fit asking for permission.
b14c6b9577d3ab92.zh: 「앉고도」表示「即使坐了也…」，不符合請求許可的用法。

b309dc5d53921119.zh: 形容詞詞幹「춥-」直接加「-죠」，表示詢問已知的一般事實。
b309dc5d53921119.en: The adjective stem 춥- attaches directly to -죠 to confirm a general fact.

b309dc5d53921119.zh: 此處詢問韓國冬天的普遍氣候，應使用現在式而非過去式「추웠죠」。
b309dc5d53921119.en: 추웠죠 asks about past weather, but this question asks about general winter climate.

b309dc5d53921119.zh: 「-이-」是用於名詞的指定詞，形容詞詞幹「춥-」直接接「-죠」。
b309dc5d53921119.en: -이- is used only after nouns; predicate stems take -죠 directly.

b309dc5d53921119.zh: 「-지요」接詞幹時不產生「ㅂ」不規則變化，因此保留「춥죠」。
b309dc5d53921119.en: ㅂ-irregular verbs do not change before -지요, so 추우죠 is incorrect.

b3dbd7967274cd5e.zh: 賓語「이름을」與地點「여기에」在前，副詞「크게」修飾動詞「써」，後接「주세요」。
b3dbd7967274cd5e.en: The object 이름을 and location 여기에 precede the adverb 크게, which correctly modifies the verb 써 followed by 주세요.

b9a61ac1b20bbb8c.zh: 有「아까」（剛才），動詞過去推測要接「-(으)ㄴ 것 같다」，故用「간」。
b9a61ac1b20bbb8c.en: With 아까 (a while ago), past guess for verbs takes -(으)ㄴ 것 같다, so 간 is correct.

b9a61ac1b20bbb8c.zh: 「가는 것 같다」表示現在正在進行或一般的推測，不符合句中的「아까」。
b9a61ac1b20bbb8c.en: 가는 것 같다 expresses a guess about the present, which conflicts with 아까 (a while ago).

b9a61ac1b20bbb8c.zh: 「갈 것 같다」表示未來的推測，不符合「아까」（剛才）的過去語境。
b9a61ac1b20bbb8c.en: 갈 것 같다 expresses a guess about future action, which doesn't fit the past adverb 아까.

b9a61ac1b20bbb8c.zh: 動詞過去推測接「-(으)ㄴ 것 같다」，不可寫成「-았/었는 것 같다」。
b9a61ac1b20bbb8c.en: Past modifier for verbs takes -(으)ㄴ 것 같다; 갔는 것 같다 is grammatically incorrect.

ba4a94e72a12bc63.zh: 動詞詞幹「자-」接「-기 전에」表睡前，後接賓語「책을」與謂語「읽어요」。
ba4a94e72a12bc63.en: The stem 자- takes -기 전에 to mean before sleeping, followed by object 책을 and verb 읽어요.

ba954d84d13f42b0.en: 열려 comes from passive verb 열리다, which combines with -어 있다 to show the state of being open.
ba954d84d13f42b0.zh: 自動詞被動態「열리다」接「-어 있다」，表示窗戶「開著」的持續狀態。

ba954d84d13f42b0.en: 열고 would indicate someone is actively opening the window, which does not match subject 창문.
ba954d84d13f42b0.zh: 「열고 있다」表示某人正在開窗的進行動作，主詞為「窗戶」時不合適。

ba954d84d13f42b0.en: 열어 from transitive 열다 cannot pair with -아 있다 to describe an object's state.
ba954d84d13f42b0.zh: 「열다」為他動詞，接「-아 있다」文法不通，狀態持續需用被動詞「열리다」。

ba954d84d13f42b0.en: 열리고 있다 would mean the window is in the middle of opening right now, not already open.
ba954d84d13f42b0.zh: 「열리고 있다」表示正在被打開的過程，非指維持開啟的結果狀態。

bab19d93ec3eab39.zh: 「벗다」的母音為ㅓ，接「-어도 되다」表示可以不脫。
bab19d93ec3eab39.en: The stem 벗- has the vowel ㅓ, so it correctly takes -어도 되다.
The stem vowel is ㅓ, so it cannot take -아도.

bab19d93ec3eab39.zh: 表示許可的文法是「-아/어도 되다」，不能省略「-어-」。
bab19d93ec3eab39.en: The permission pattern requires -아/어도; 벗도 is missing the connecting vowel.

bab19d93ec3eab39.zh: 表示一般的許可或規則時，詞幹不加過去式標記「-었-」。
bab19d93ec3eab39.en: General permission does not use the past-tense marker -었-.

bb0cc5401d09a73d.en: Nouns take 때 directly without any particle or verb ending to mean during.
bb0cc5401d09a73d.zh: 名詞後面直接加上「때」即可表示「…的時候」。

bb0cc5401d09a73d.en: Korean does not use the possessive marker 의 before 때 in this structure.
bb0cc5401d09a73d.zh: 韓語中名詞與때之間不加屬格助詞「의 때」。

bb0cc5401d09a73d.en: 방학 is a noun, not a verb stem, so adding 할 때 is incorrect.
bb0cc5401d09a73d.zh: 「방학」是名詞而非動詞，不能接「할 때」。

bb0cc5401d09a73d.en: The particle 에 cannot be inserted between a noun and 때.
bb0cc5401d09a73d.zh: 名詞與때之間不可插入時間或地點助詞「에 때」。

bd61050ef8dc6932.en: 먹다 has the stem vowel ㅓ, so it takes -어야 to express obligation.
bd61050ef8dc6932.zh: 「먹다」母音為陰性「ㅓ」，依規則應接「-어야 돼요」。

bd61050ef8dc6932.en: -아야 only attaches to stems ending with the vowels ㅏ or ㅗ.
bd61050ef8dc6932.zh: 「-아야」只接在詞幹母音為「ㅏ」或「ㅗ」的動詞後面。

bd61050ef8dc6932.en: 먹야 misses the required connecting vowel -어- needed for the pattern.
bd61050ef8dc6932.zh: 遺漏了接續母音「-어-」，形態不完整。

bd61050ef8dc6932.en: 먹고야 uses the connective -고, which cannot form the obligation pattern with -야 돼요.
bd61050ef8dc6932.zh: 「-고」表示並列或時間先後，不能接「-야 돼요」表義務。

bdea9df570a694f8.en: Correct. -(으)ㄹ 줄 알다 shows ability or knowledge of how to do something.
bdea9df570a694f8.zh: 表示會不會某技能用「-(으)ㄹ 줄 알다」，「하다」接「할」。

bdea9df570a694f8.en: 하는 is the present modifier; -(으)ㄹ is required before 줄 알다.
bdea9df570a694f8.zh: 「하는」是現在修飾形，在此無法表示「會」這項技能。

bdea9df570a694f8.en: 한 is the past modifier and cannot be used in this ability pattern.
bdea9df570a694f8.zh: 「한」是過去修飾形，不能用於「-(으)ㄹ 줄 알다」能力句型。

bdea9df570a694f8.en: 해 is a sentence ending or connective form, unable to modify 줄.
bdea9df570a694f8.zh: 「해」為非格式體終結詞尾，無法修飾著名詞「줄」。

bfd2aecefa17a109.zh: 形容詞「무겁다」為 ㅂ 不規則變化，遇到元音變為「무거우-」，故接「무거운」。
bfd2aecefa17a109.en: 무겁다 is a ㅂ-irregular adjective: ㅂ changes to 우 before vowels, yielding 무거운.

bfd2aecefa17a109.zh: 「-는 것 같다」用於動詞現在式，形容詞不可接「-는 것 같다」。
bfd2aecefa17a109.en: -는 것 같다 is used with verbs for present guesses; adjectives take -(으)ㄴ 것 같다.

bfd2aecefa17a109.zh: 「무겁다」是 ㅂ 不規則變化，不是單純脫落 ㅂ，型態錯誤。
bfd2aecefa17a109.en: 무겁다 does not conjugate to 무거는; it requires the irregular ㅂ to 우 change.

bfd2aecefa17a109.zh: 「무겁다」為 ㅂ 不規則變化，遇元音時 ㅂ 會轉化，不能規則變化為「무겁은」。
bfd2aecefa17a109.en: 무겁다 is irregular before vowel endings, so it cannot simply add 은 as 무겁은.

c0441122615875a9.en: 씻다 has the dark vowel ㅣ, so it correctly takes -어서.
씻다 does not contain a bright vowel, so -아서 is incorrect.
The past tense infix -었- cannot be used before -어서.
씻으면 means if I wash it, which expresses condition, not sequence.
c0441122615875a9.zh: 「씻으면」表示假設「如果洗的話」，不符語境。

c04dc23e0297929f.en: The stem 오- contracts with -아도 into 와도; 안 와도 돼요 means you do not have to come.
c04dc23e0297929f.zh: 「오다」與「-아도」結合為「와도」，搭配「안 … 돼요」表示不必做。

c04dc23e0297929f.en: The stem 오- must contract with -아도 into 와도, not 오도.
c04dc23e0297929f.zh: 「오다」與「-아도」結合時必須縮約為「와도」，不能寫成「오도」。

c04dc23e0297929f.en: The ending 와서 expresses reason or sequential action, not permission or lack of necessity.
c04dc23e0297929f.zh: 「와서」表示原因或順序「因為來了／來了之後」，不符合此句型。

c04dc23e0297929f.en: The form 오면 means if you come, which does not express you do not have to come.
c04dc23e0297929f.zh: 「오면」表示「如果來」，與後文「돼요」無法表達「不用來也可以」。

c33801de7c5171da.en: 춥다 drops ㅂ to become 추우- and takes 니까, valid before the suggestion -읍시다.
c33801de7c5171da.zh: 「춥다」為ㅂ不規則，變成「추우」後接「니까」，後句可接提議句。

c33801de7c5171da.en: Clauses ending with -어서 cannot lead into a proposal ending like -읍시다.
춥다 is an irregular ㅂ verb; it changes before vowels and cannot form 춥으니까.
c33801de7c5171da.zh: 「춥다」是ㅂ不規則動詞，遇到母音會變化，不能直接接「으니까」。

c33801de7c5171da.en: 춥니까 is grammatically invalid because it ignores both the 받침 and the ㅂ-irregular rule.
c33801de7c5171da.zh: 「춥다」有收音不能直接加「니까」，且未做ㅂ不規則變化。

c35191876c50fabd.zh: 地點副詞接 취직하려고 表就業意圖，受詞 한국어를 接最後動詞 배워요。
c35191876c50fabd.en: 한국 회사에 취직하려고 establishes the purpose, followed by object 한국어를 and main verb 배워요.

c3d289fc96f0172f.en: 예쁘다 has no final consonant, so it takes ㄴ to modify 꽃.
c3d289fc96f0172f.zh: 形容詞「예쁘다」無收音，接「-ㄴ」修飾名詞成「예쁜」。

c3d289fc96f0172f.en: 예쁘- ends in a vowel, so 은 cannot attach to it.
c3d289fc96f0172f.zh: 詞幹「예쁘-」以母音結尾，不需也不可接「은」。

c3d289fc96f0172f.en: -는 is used with verbs, not ordinary adjectives.
c3d289fc96f0172f.zh: 「-는」通常用於動詞現在式修飾名詞，形容詞不可用。

c3d289fc96f0172f.en: 예뻐 is an informal sentence ending, not a noun modifier.
c3d289fc96f0172f.zh: 「예뻐」是非格式體終結語尾，不能直接放在名詞前作修飾。

c575b6601dc2be56.en: 고프다 becomes 고파 and takes 서 to express reason (because).
고 connects actions/states neutrally and attaches to stems, not 고파.
c575b6601dc2be56.zh: 「고」接在原形詞幹後表示並列，且前面不應是「고파」。

c575b6601dc2be56.en: 지만 means but and attaches to the basic stem, not 고파.
c575b6601dc2be56.zh: 「지만」接在詞幹後表示轉折，不能接在「고파」後。

c575b6601dc2be56.en: 면 expresses a condition (if) and attaches to the basic stem.
c575b6601dc2be56.zh: 「면」接在詞幹後表示條件「如果」，不能接在「고파」後。

c7087749b19258c7.en: The stem of 먹다 ends in a consonant, so it takes -은 후에 to mean after doing.
c7087749b19258c7.zh: 動詞詞幹末尾有收音，接「-은 후에」表示做完某事之後。

c7087749b19258c7.en: The present modifier -는 cannot attach to 후에 to mean after doing.
c7087749b19258c7.zh: 「-는」是現在式冠形詞尾，不能與「후에」搭配表示做完之後。

c7087749b19258c7.en: The suffix -을 indicates future or conjecture, not after completing an action.
c7087749b19258c7.zh: 「-을」是未來式或推測冠形詞尾，不符合「在…之後」的句型。

c7087749b19258c7.en: The nominalizer -기 cannot directly attach to 후에 for after doing something.
c7087749b19258c7.zh: 「-기」將動詞轉為名詞，不能直接接「후에」表達「在…之後」。

c744ca93ed49d04c.en: 됐어요 completes the -게 되다 grammar to mean 'came to like' due to external change.
c744ca93ed49d04c.zh: 「좋아하게 됐어요」符合「-게 되다」句型，表示自然而然「變得喜歡」。

c744ca93ed49d04c.en: 했어요 with -게 forms a causative ('made someone like'), rather than a personal change of state.
c744ca93ed49d04c.zh: 「좋아하게 했어요」表示使役（讓某人喜歡），與自身轉變為喜歡的意思不合。

c744ca93ed49d04c.en: 졌어요 belongs to the pattern -아/어지다 and cannot follow the connective -게.
있어요 cannot attach to -게 to indicate a change of state or habit.
c744ca93ed49d04c.zh: 「좋아하게 있어요」文法不成立，「-게」不能直接接「있어요」表示變化。

c857720a0ef25992.en: The verb 하다 irregularly contracts with -아야/어야 to become 해야.
c857720a0ef25992.zh: 動詞「하다」加上表示義務的「-아야/어야 하다」時規則變為「해야」。

c857720a0ef25992.en: 하야 is an incorrect conjugation; 하다 always combines with -아야/어야 as 해.
c857720a0ef25992.zh: 「하야」是錯誤形態，「하다」的結合規則一定是變成「해」。

c857720a0ef25992.en: 하어야 is grammatically non-existent; 하다 always becomes 해야.
c857720a0ef25992.zh: 「하어야」形態不正確，韓語中沒有這種組合方式。

c857720a0ef25992.en: The obligation pattern attaches to the basic verb stem, not the past tense stem 했.
c857720a0ef25992.zh: 「-아야/어야 하다」必須接在動詞詞幹後，不能加過去式「했」。

c87049be1ffcccdf.zh: 動詞詞幹後接「-고 나서」表示動作完成後接續下一動作。
c87049be1ffcccdf.en: -고 나서 attaches to the stem 하다 as 하고 나서 to mean after finishing.

c87049be1ffcccdf.zh: 「해」為非格式體終結或-아/어形，不能直接接「나서」。
c87049be1ffcccdf.en: 해 cannot directly combine with 나서; the grammar form is -고 나서.
The past tense 했- cannot be used before -고 나서.

c87049be1ffcccdf.zh: 「-기 나서」並非正確的語法接續方式。
c87049be1ffcccdf.en: 하기 나서 is ungrammatical; the pattern requires the connective -고.

c8a865ece33cb279.en: Correct. The irregular verb 듣다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ before vowels, becoming 들으면서.
듣면서 is missing the required vowel 으 after a final consonant.
들면서 incorrectly drops the intervening vowel 으.
듣으면서 fails to apply the irregular ㄷ to ㄹ change before vowels.

c920271a8960e1ea.en: 됐어요 from 되다 is the standard verb paired with -(으)ㄴ 지 to express elapsed time.
c920271a8960e1ea.zh: 表示「時間過去了」固定搭配動詞「되다」，故用「됐어요」。

c920271a8960e1ea.en: 있어요 expresses existence or possession and is not used with the -(으)ㄴ 지 structure.
c920271a8960e1ea.zh: 「있어요」表示存在或擁有，不能搭配「-(으)ㄴ 지」表示時間經過。

c920271a8960e1ea.en: 했어요 means did and cannot be used to indicate that an amount of time has passed.
c920271a8960e1ea.zh: 「했어요」表示「做了」，在此句型中不能表示時間的流逝。

c920271a8960e1ea.en: 졌어요 means lost or became, which makes no sense with elapsed time.
c920271a8960e1ea.zh: 「졌어요」是「輸了」或「-어지다」的過去形，語意完全不合。

c9c6173ff54696ab.zh: 제가 引導子句，動詞 샤워하는 修飾 동안，後接主句主詞 전화가。
c9c6173ff54696ab.en: Subject 제가 leads the modifying clause 샤워하는 into 동안, followed by the main subject 전화가.

c9eb8503fbb5e40c.en: -(으)러 is used specifically with motion verbs like 가다 to indicate purpose.
c9eb8503fbb5e40c.zh: 後方接移動動詞「가다」且表示「去做某事」時，使用「-(으)러」。

c9eb8503fbb5e40c.en: -(으)려고 cannot be followed by suggestive or imperative endings like -ㅂ시다.
c9eb8503fbb5e40c.zh: 「-(으)려고」後句不能使用勸誘句「-ㅂ시다」或命令句。

c9eb8503fbb5e40c.en: -도록 indicates an extent or in order that, not purpose with motion verbs.
c9eb8503fbb5e40c.zh: 「-도록」表示結果程度或使動，不符「一同去買」的移動目的。

c9eb8503fbb5e40c.en: -자마자 means as soon as, which makes no sense before 같이 갑시다.
c9eb8503fbb5e40c.zh: 「-자마자」表示「一…就…」，不符合「一起去買麵包」的語意。

ca40d87dcda74434.en: For past noun modification, stems without a final consonant take ㄴ, yielding 산.
ca40d87dcda74434.zh: 過去修飾名詞且詞幹無收音時，接ㄴ成為「산」。

ca40d87dcda74434.en: 사는 is the present modifier form, which means clothes that I buy.
ca40d87dcda74434.zh: 「사는」是現在修飾形，意思是「買的／住的」。

ca40d87dcda74434.en: 살 is the future modifier form, meaning clothes I will buy.
ca40d87dcda74434.zh: 「살」是未來修飾形，意思是「打算要買的衣服」。

ca40d87dcda74434.en: The past modifier attaches to the basic stem, not to the past stem 샀, making 샀은 invalid.
ca40d87dcda74434.zh: 過去修飾直接在原形詞幹接(으)ㄴ，「샀은」是錯誤形態。

ca6059d4a929a41d.zh: 「만들다」詞幹以ㄹ結尾，接「-(으)ㄹ 줄 알다」時直接作「만들」。
